1	/**
2	 * Vendored fork of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-sqlite` (`index.ts`).
3	 *
4	 * Source: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
5	 * `packages/storage/storage-sqlite/src/index.ts` at version 0.1.5-rc.2
6	 * (MIT per that version's package metadata and the repo root LICENSE;
7	 * the stale npm `latest` tag 0.0.1-rc.1 carries BSD-3-Clause metadata).
8	 * Kept identical except the `@module` tag below.
9	 *
10	 * Why vendored instead of depended on: DSH Desktop generation installers
11	 * strip `@deepseek-ai/*` copies and resolve them from the host closure,
12	 * which ships no `dsh-storage-sqlite` — a loader row naming that package
13	 * blocks boot (GitHub issue #28). Resolving from our own package survives
14	 * that boundary. Sync procedure: diff against the upstream file on every
15	 * DSH compat round (see docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md).
16	 */
17	
18	/**
19	 * SQLite storage backend for the storage hub: one database file hosts every
20	 * routed unit, document-per-row (`key TEXT` / `value TEXT` JSON). Registers
21	 * as backend `sqlite`; the disposer unregisters first, then closes the medium.
22	 * @module @contexera/dsh-agent-team/sqlite-backend
23	 */
24	
25	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
26	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
27	import type { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
28	import { StorageError, UNIT_NAME_RE, storageBackendServiceKey } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
29	import type { KvFacet, KvUnit, KvUnitDescriptor, StorageBackend } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
30	import { openDatabase, recordTableName, type JournalMode } from './schema.ts'
31	import { SqliteKvUnit } from './unit.ts'
32	
33	export { STORAGE_SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION, type JournalMode } from './schema.ts'
34	
35	/** Cordis plugin name. */
36	export const name = 'storage-sqlite'
37	/** The backend registers on the storage hub. */
38	export const inject = ['storage']
39	
40	/** Plugin configuration. */
41	export interface Config {
42	  /**
43	   * Filesystem path to the SQLite database file. The special value `:memory:`
44	   * opens an in-process database (tests). On filesystems with POSIX modes,
45	   * missing directories and databases are created owner-only; existing path
46	   * modes are preserved. Filesystem setup errors other than an existing
47	   * database fail the open. The backend does not protect confidentiality or
48	   * integrity when another principal can replace the database entry in its
49	   * parent directory.
50	   */
51	  path: string
52	  /**
53	   * SQLite `journal_mode` pragma. `wal` (the default) suits local disks; pick
54	   * a rollback-journal mode (`delete`/`truncate`/`persist`) on filesystems
55	   * where WAL's shared-memory files do not work (network mounts). See
56	   * {@link JournalMode}.
57	   */
58	  journalMode?: JournalMode
59	}
60	
61	/** Schemastery validator for {@link Config}. */
62	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
63	  path: z.string().required(),
64	  journalMode: z.union(['wal', 'delete', 'truncate', 'persist'] as const).default('wal'),
65	})
66	
67	/**
68	 * The SQLite {@link StorageBackend}. Owns one `DatabaseSync` connection and
69	 * the open-unit table; `kv.open` validates names, enforces the per-unit
70	 * version stamp in `units`, and ensures the unit's record tables.
71	 */
72	export class SqliteStorageBackend implements StorageBackend {
73	  /** The key-value facet; the only shape this backend serves. */
74	  readonly kv: KvFacet = { open: descriptor => this.openUnit(descriptor) }
75	
76	  private readonly ready: Promise<DatabaseSync>
77	  /** Open (or still-opening) units by name; presence is the double-open guard. */
78	  private readonly units = new Map<string, Promise<SqliteKvUnit>>()
79	  private closing: Promise<void> | undefined
80	
81	  /**
82	   * @param config - Validated plugin configuration.
83	   */
84	  constructor(config: Config) {
85	    this.ready = openDatabase(config.path, (config as Required<Config>).journalMode)
86	    // Mark the rejection handled: every primitive re-awaits `ready`, so an
87	    // open failure still surfaces to each caller; this guard only prevents an
88	    // unhandled-rejection crash when the failure precedes the first use.
89	    this.ready.catch(() => {})
90	  }
91	
92	  private openUnit(descriptor: KvUnitDescriptor): Promise<KvUnit> {
93	    if (this.closing !== undefined) {
94	      return Promise.reject(new StorageError('closed', 'sqlite storage backend is closed'))
95	    }
96	    if (!UNIT_NAME_RE.test(descriptor.name)) {
97	      return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv unit name '${descriptor.name}' violates ${UNIT_NAME_RE}`))
98	    }
99	    for (const table of descriptor.tables) {
100	      if (!UNIT_NAME_RE.test(table)) {
101	        return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv table name '${table}' in unit '${descriptor.name}' violates ${UNIT_NAME_RE}`))
102	      }
103	    }
104	    if (this.units.has(descriptor.name)) {
105	      return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv unit '${descriptor.name}' is already open (double-open is a caller bug)`))
106	    }
107	    // Reserve the name synchronously so a concurrent second open of the same
108	    // name rejects instead of racing past the guard during the awaits below.
109	    const pending = this.materializeUnit(descriptor)
110	    this.units.set(descriptor.name, pending)
111	    pending.catch(() => this.units.delete(descriptor.name))
112	    return pending
113	  }
114	
115	  private async materializeUnit(descriptor: KvUnitDescriptor): Promise<SqliteKvUnit> {
116	    const db = await this.ready
117	    const row = db.prepare('SELECT version FROM units WHERE name = ?').get(descriptor.name) as
118	      | { version: number }
119	      | undefined
120	    if (row === undefined) {
121	      db.prepare('INSERT INTO units (name, version) VALUES (?, ?)').run(descriptor.name, descriptor.version)
122	    } else if (row.version !== descriptor.version) {
123	      throw new StorageError(
124	        'version-mismatch',
125	        `kv unit '${descriptor.name}' is stamped version ${row.version} on the medium, incompatible with descriptor version ${descriptor.version}`,
126	      )
127	    }
128	    for (const table of descriptor.tables) {
129	      // Both segments passed UNIT_NAME_RE, so the identifier is safe in DDL.
130	      db.exec(`
131	        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "${recordTableName(descriptor.name, table)}" (
132	          key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
133	          value TEXT NOT NULL
134	        ) STRICT
135	      `)
136	    }
137	    return new SqliteKvUnit(db, descriptor, () => {
138	      this.units.delete(descriptor.name)
139	    })
140	  }
141	
142	  /**
143	   * Close every open unit and release the database. Idempotent; concurrent
144	   * and repeated calls resolve once teardown finishes.
145	   * @returns resolution after the medium is released.
146	   */
147	  close(): Promise<void> {
148	    this.closing ??= this.doClose()
149	    return this.closing
150	  }
151	
152	  private async doClose(): Promise<void> {
153	    let db: DatabaseSync
154	    try {
155	      db = await this.ready
156	    } catch {
157	      // The medium never opened; that failure already rejected the opener and
158	      // every unit call, so there is nothing left to release here.
159	      return
160	    }
161	    for (const pending of [...this.units.values()]) {
162	      const unit = await pending.catch(() => undefined)
163	      await unit?.close()
164	    }
165	    db.close()
166	  }
167	}
168	
169	/**
170	 * Register the SQLite backend as `sqlite` on the storage hub. The disposer
171	 * unregisters the name first, then closes the backend.
172	 * @param ctx - Plugin context (must inject `storage`).
173	 * @param config - Validated plugin configuration.
174	 */
175	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config) {
176	  const backend = new SqliteStorageBackend(config)
177	  ctx.effect(() => {
178	    const dispose = ctx.storage.backend.register('sqlite', backend)
179	    return async () => {
180	      dispose()
181	      await backend.close()
182	    }
183	  }, 'storage-sqlite.registerBackend')
184	  ctx.provide(storageBackendServiceKey('sqlite'), backend)
185	}

152	## 8. Agent context
153	
154	| 层 | 内容 |
155	| --- | --- |
156	| persona（常驻） | 行为规则（消息形态、何时找 Human、礼仪）+ 8 行以内的角色速查；整体改写，删除 `@all`、Human-only 邀请/验收、顶层消息建 Thread、mention 恢复 Attention、`team_claim` 等过期条目 |
157	| 每步动态 context | 现有身份、memory index、Workspace 列表 + 一块“你是哪些 Project 的 owner”；内容不变则不重复注入；不带 Task 状态 |
158	| Inbox notice | 每条带 delivery、cause、scope（Main stream / Thread / Task）、本 scope 内角色、source ref、读取入口 |
159	| `team-domain-model` core skill（按需） | 角色与权限、Main stream 与 Thread 的分工、点名/回复/普通消息的投递差别、何时看 board、Task 生命周期与验收、DM 用途、常见拒绝与恢复；不含任何当前状态 |
160	
161	权限、Inbox、投递、steer 与 replay 始终由 Host 负责；skill 与 prompt 只减少模型犯错。
162

packages/tool-agent-team/README.zh.md-10-- `team_thread` 读取 Thread、分页历史。`threadRef` 是主身份；`taskRef` 只对 released task-only Client 是 Host alias。三个 action 分开渲染：`read` 渲染结果、Thread 身份、导向（有 Host 提供的 background 时给 full anchor，否则给 bounded anchor subject——重新进入自己读过的 Thread 的 Member 完全没有 background，它在那里的定位就是该 subject 加本次 batch——anchor 已在 facts 中时绝不重复）、只含 active Claims、带行内 unread/direct 标记的按时间 facts、read-through/剩余未读页脚（只要这次 read 身后留有 Thread facts，页脚同时给出那些 facts 的数量）；`history` 渲染历史页（首页 full anchor、continuation 页 bounded subject，绝无当前 Claims 或上下文建议）。`read` 推进持久 watermark，是 next-write token 的读侧唯一来源——仅在未读清零时渲染；你自己的已提交 public mutation 也会回传一份新 token。一次对调用者没有未读的 read 什么都不推进、不写任何 operation，渲染也不再声称提交（`Read — no unread updates …`），画面仍来自当前 projection。Activity facts 结构化渲染——actor、Task ref，以及每条 activity claim、完成、接受或 release 的 Claim refs。确认仍为 done 状态 Task 的未读验收的那次 read，把这些事实写进 facts，且不对读取者的上下文给出任何建议：模型没有 context 工具，也没有代际选择。
packages/tool-agent-team/README.zh.md-11-- `team_attention` 只回答你是否关注某个 Thread：`status` 只报告、不改变任何东西，`follow` 与 `unfollow` 改变 Attention。三者参数完全相同——Thread 地址与路由 Workspace——并渲染一行：Thread ref、可选 Task standing 与 following 状态。Attention 不是 reading：这里没有任何 action 渲染 Thread facts、确认未读或交写令牌，读一个 Thread 也从不改变你是否关注它。
packages/tool-agent-team/README.zh.md-12-- `team_message` 在 Project 的 Main stream 发言、创建顶层 Thread、回复既有 Thread。`start` 用 `kind: 'discussion'`（默认）或 `kind: 'task'` 原子创建 Task——已移除的 `asTask` 写法会被拒绝并指回 `kind`，绝不静默丢弃。Task start 另接受 `accountable`（Project owner 的 memberRef，或 `human`）与 `sourceThreadRefs`（派生自哪些讨论 Thread，卡片因此渲染在那里而非 Main stream）；两者在讨论 start 以及 `post`/`reply` 上都被拒绝而非丢弃，commit 的 start 回报实际记录的负责人。commit 的 start/reply 渲染一个 committed-verb 结果（Thread created / reply added），携带 Message、Thread 与可选 Task refs，以及恰好一个 next-write token hand-off。Reply 在检查令牌新鲜度前先拒绝未读工作。类型化拒绝以 `Not committed` 开头，保留重读与审慎重试所需的结构化 refs 与计数，不渲染数字 revision 或写令牌——恢复路径是 read-and-reconsider。
packages/tool-agent-team/README.zh.md-13-- `team_dm` 向同一 Workspace 内一个 enabled Agent Member 发送一条私有 direct message。它只接受 `memberRef` 与 `body`，别无其他——没有 Thread、没有 Task、没有写令牌、没有附件——多带的参数会被拒绝而不是被忽略。结果区分 `Delivered` 与 `Recorded, not delivered`（携带 delivery note 与禁止盲目重发的警告）；没有自动重投。Human 不能被 DM。
packages/tool-agent-team/README.zh.md:14:- `team_task` 通过 `board` 读取 Task board，通过 `list` 列出单个 Task 的 active Claims，通过 `claim`、`done`、`release` 修改调用方 Member 的 Direction Claim，通过 `accept`、`close`、`reopen`、`transfer` 了结或转交 Task，`promote` 则供 Project owner 把讨论 Thread 升格为 Task；它只适用于真实 Task。`board` 显示 open Task 与每个项目最近完成的 Task，每行给出 accountable owner，以及读者可验收时的待验收标记；`mine` 只留读者负责或正在执行的 Task。`list` 渲染 Task/Thread 身份与只有 active Claims 的 collision surface，且无写令牌。commit 的 mutation 点名动作（Claim created/completed/released、Thread promoted、Task accepted/closed/reopened/transferred），先渲染权威的受影响 Claim，再 hand-off 一个 next-write token。谁能 accept、close、reopen 或 transfer 由 Host 决定而非工具：工具只转发 action 与写令牌，`self_acceptance_forbidden` 或 `accountable_owner_required` 拒绝的出路来自 Host 的 recovery registry，并补上 Task 的当前状态与 accountable owner——那只有拒绝之后调用方自己才读得到。拒绝与 message 拒绝共享同一形式。Direction 互斥键执行 Unicode NFKC normalization、trim、空白压缩和确定性大小写折叠。
packages/tool-agent-team/README.zh.md-15-- `team_view` 是 address book：有界、按 membership 授权的 Project、顶层 Thread 与 Member 摘要——是当前的地址簿，不是工作队列。Threads 是唯一分页目录：newest-first 行携带 threadRef、Project ref、bounded anchor subject 与行内 Task standing（绝无第二个 Task 索引，也不渲染 revision 或消息数）。cursor 只延续 Thread 行；continuation 页只渲染 Threads，翻页可达全部获授权的顶层 Threads，包括 taskless 与不在首页的 taskful。

packages/tool-agent-team/README.md-10-- `team_thread` reads a Thread, pages its history, or reads one Message back by ref. `threadRef` is primary; a `taskRef` is a Host alias only for released task-only Clients. `beforeSequence`/`limit` are history-only: any other action that carries them is refused with the route (`read` drains unread and cannot page — use `action: history`). The three actions render separately: `read` renders outcome, Thread identity, orientation (full anchor when Host-supplied background is present, bounded anchor subject otherwise — and no background at all for a Member re-entering a Thread it has already read, so its orientation there is that subject plus this batch — never a duplicate of an in-facts anchor), active Claims only, the chronological facts with inline unread/direct markers, and a read-through/remaining-unread footer that also states how many Thread facts precede the watermark whenever the read left any behind; `history` renders a historical page with the full anchor on a first page and the bounded subject on continuation pages, never current Claims or a context recommendation; `message` reads one Message back verbatim by ref. `read` advances the durable watermark and is the only read-side source of a next-write token — rendered only when no unread remains; your own committed public mutations hand off a fresh token as well. A read with nothing unread for the caller advances nothing, writes no operation, and renders `Read — no unread updates …` instead of claiming a commit, still answering from the current projection. Activity facts render structured — actor, Task ref, and the Claim refs each activity claimed, completed, accepted, or released. A read that acknowledges an unread acceptance of a still-done Task states that acceptance in its facts and recommends nothing about the reader's context: the model has no context tool and no generation choice.
packages/tool-agent-team/README.md-11-- `team_attention` answers only whether you follow a Thread: `status` reports and changes nothing, `follow` and `unfollow` change Attention. All three take the same parameters — the Thread address and the routing Workspace — and render one line with the Thread ref, optional Task standing, and following state. Attention is not reading: no action here renders Thread facts, acknowledges unread work, or hands off a write token, and reading a Thread never changes whether you follow it.

1	/**
2	 * Vendored fork of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-sqlite` (`index.ts`).
3	 *
4	 * Source: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
5	 * `packages/storage/storage-sqlite/src/index.ts` at version 0.1.5-rc.2
6	 * (MIT per that version's package metadata and the repo root LICENSE;
7	 * the stale npm `latest` tag 0.0.1-rc.1 carries BSD-3-Clause metadata).
8	 * Kept identical except the `@module` tag below.
9	 *
10	 * Why vendored instead of depended on: DSH Desktop generation installers
11	 * strip `@deepseek-ai/*` copies and resolve them from the host closure,
12	 * which ships no `dsh-storage-sqlite` — a loader row naming that package
13	 * blocks boot (GitHub issue #28). Resolving from our own package survives
14	 * that boundary. Sync procedure: diff against the upstream file on every
15	 * DSH compat round (see docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md).
16	 */
17	
18	/**
19	 * SQLite storage backend for the storage hub: one database file hosts every
20	 * routed unit, document-per-row (`key TEXT` / `value TEXT` JSON). Registers
21	 * as backend `sqlite`; the disposer unregisters first, then closes the medium.
22	 * @module @contexera/dsh-agent-team/sqlite-backend
23	 */
24	
25	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
26	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
27	import type { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
28	import { StorageError, UNIT_NAME_RE, storageBackendServiceKey } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
29	import type { KvFacet, KvUnit, KvUnitDescriptor, StorageBackend } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
30	import { openDatabase, recordTableName, type JournalMode } from './schema.ts'
31	import { SqliteKvUnit } from './unit.ts'
32	
33	export { STORAGE_SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION, type JournalMode } from './schema.ts'
34	
35	/** Cordis plugin name. */
36	export const name = 'storage-sqlite'
37	/** The backend registers on the storage hub. */
38	export const inject = ['storage']
39	
40	/** Plugin configuration. */
41	export interface Config {
42	  /**
43	   * Filesystem path to the SQLite database file. The special value `:memory:`
44	   * opens an in-process database (tests). On filesystems with POSIX modes,
45	   * missing directories and databases are created owner-only; existing path
46	   * modes are preserved. Filesystem setup errors other than an existing
47	   * database fail the open. The backend does not protect confidentiality or
48	   * integrity when another principal can replace the database entry in its
49	   * parent directory.
50	   */
51	  path: string
52	  /**
53	   * SQLite `journal_mode` pragma. `wal` (the default) suits local disks; pick
54	   * a rollback-journal mode (`delete`/`truncate`/`persist`) on filesystems
55	   * where WAL's shared-memory files do not work (network mounts). See
56	   * {@link JournalMode}.
57	   */
58	  journalMode?: JournalMode
59	}
60	
61	/** Schemastery validator for {@link Config}. */
62	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
63	  path: z.string().required(),
64	  journalMode: z.union(['wal', 'delete', 'truncate', 'persist'] as const).default('wal'),
65	})
66	
67	/**
68	 * The SQLite {@link StorageBackend}. Owns one `DatabaseSync` connection and
69	 * the open-unit table; `kv.open` validates names, enforces the per-unit
70	 * version stamp in `units`, and ensures the unit's record tables.
71	 */
72	export class SqliteStorageBackend implements StorageBackend {
73	  /** The key-value facet; the only shape this backend serves. */
74	  readonly kv: KvFacet = { open: descriptor => this.openUnit(descriptor) }
75	
76	  private readonly ready: Promise<DatabaseSync>
77	  /** Open (or still-opening) units by name; presence is the double-open guard. */
78	  private readonly units = new Map<string, Promise<SqliteKvUnit>>()
79	  private closing: Promise<void> | undefined
80	
81	  /**
82	   * @param config - Validated plugin configuration.
83	   */
84	  constructor(config: Config) {
85	    this.ready = openDatabase(config.path, (config as Required<Config>).journalMode)
86	    // Mark the rejection handled: every primitive re-awaits `ready`, so an
87	    // open failure still surfaces to each caller; this guard only prevents an
88	    // unhandled-rejection crash when the failure precedes the first use.
89	    this.ready.catch(() => {})
90	  }
91	
92	  private openUnit(descriptor: KvUnitDescriptor): Promise<KvUnit> {
93	    if (this.closing !== undefined) {
94	      return Promise.reject(new StorageError('closed', 'sqlite storage backend is closed'))
95	    }
96	    if (!UNIT_NAME_RE.test(descriptor.name)) {
97	      return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv unit name '${descriptor.name}' violates ${UNIT_NAME_RE}`))
98	    }
99	    for (const table of descriptor.tables) {
100	      if (!UNIT_NAME_RE.test(table)) {
101	        return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv table name '${table}' in unit '${descriptor.name}' violates ${UNIT_NAME_RE}`))
102	      }
103	    }
104	    if (this.units.has(descriptor.name)) {
105	      return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv unit '${descriptor.name}' is already open (double-open is a caller bug)`))
106	    }
107	    // Reserve the name synchronously so a concurrent second open of the same
108	    // name rejects instead of racing past the guard during the awaits below.
109	    const pending = this.materializeUnit(descriptor)
110	    this.units.set(descriptor.name, pending)
111	    pending.catch(() => this.units.delete(descriptor.name))
112	    return pending
113	  }
114	
115	  private async materializeUnit(descriptor: KvUnitDescriptor): Promise<SqliteKvUnit> {
116	    const db = await this.ready
117	    const row = db.prepare('SELECT version FROM units WHERE name = ?').get(descriptor.name) as
118	      | { version: number }
119	      | undefined
120	    if (row === undefined) {
121	      db.prepare('INSERT INTO units (name, version) VALUES (?, ?)').run(descriptor.name, descriptor.version)
122	    } else if (row.version !== descriptor.version) {
123	      throw new StorageError(
124	        'version-mismatch',
125	        `kv unit '${descriptor.name}' is stamped version ${row.version} on the medium, incompatible with descriptor version ${descriptor.version}`,
126	      )
127	    }
128	    for (const table of descriptor.tables) {
129	      // Both segments passed UNIT_NAME_RE, so the identifier is safe in DDL.
130	      db.exec(`
131	        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "${recordTableName(descriptor.name, table)}" (
132	          key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
133	          value TEXT NOT NULL
134	        ) STRICT
135	      `)
136	    }
137	    return new SqliteKvUnit(db, descriptor, () => {
138	      this.units.delete(descriptor.name)
139	    })
140	  }
141	
142	  /**
143	   * Close every open unit and release the database. Idempotent; concurrent
144	   * and repeated calls resolve once teardown finishes.
145	   * @returns resolution after the medium is released.
146	   */
147	  close(): Promise<void> {
148	    this.closing ??= this.doClose()
149	    return this.closing
150	  }
151	
152	  private async doClose(): Promise<void> {
153	    let db: DatabaseSync
154	    try {
155	      db = await this.ready
156	    } catch {
157	      // The medium never opened; that failure already rejected the opener and
158	      // every unit call, so there is nothing left to release here.
159	      return
160	    }
161	    for (const pending of [...this.units.values()]) {
162	      const unit = await pending.catch(() => undefined)
163	      await unit?.close()
164	    }
165	    db.close()
166	  }
167	}
168	
169	/**
170	 * Register the SQLite backend as `sqlite` on the storage hub. The disposer
171	 * unregisters the name first, then closes the backend.
172	 * @param ctx - Plugin context (must inject `storage`).
173	 * @param config - Validated plugin configuration.
174	 */
175	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config) {
176	  const backend = new SqliteStorageBackend(config)
177	  ctx.effect(() => {
178	    const dispose = ctx.storage.backend.register('sqlite', backend)
179	    return async () => {
180	      dispose()
181	      await backend.close()
182	    }
183	  }, 'storage-sqlite.registerBackend')
184	  ctx.provide(storageBackendServiceKey('sqlite'), backend)
185	}

1	/**
2	 * Domain declaration vocabulary. A spec object is the single source of a
3	 * domain's identity, layout, and record schemas: the owning package defines
4	 * it once with {@link defineDomain} and both the type surface and the runtime
5	 * (validation, descriptor projection) derive from it. Record schemas are zod
6	 * (`z.infer` keeps types un-duplicated and the same schemas later project to
7	 * RPC wire schemas); plugin `Config` stays schemastery.
8	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain/src/spec
9	 */
10	
11	import type { ZodType } from 'zod'
12	import { UNIT_NAME_RE, type KvUnitDescriptor } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
13	
14	/** Global singleton declaration: schema plus the value used before the first write. */
15	export interface DomainGlobalSpec<G> {
16	  /** Validates the stored global at the durable boundary. */
17	  readonly schema: ZodType<G>
18	  /** Value served when the medium holds no global yet; not written until the first `set`. */
19	  readonly initial: G
20	}
21	
22	/**
23	 * One table declaration. `K` is a phantom key type (typically a branded
24	 * string) carried for compile-time projection only; keys are plain strings on
25	 * the medium.
26	 */
27	export interface DomainTableSpec<K extends string = string, V = unknown> {
28	  /** Validates every stored record at the durable boundary. */
29	  readonly valueSchema: ZodType<V>
30	  /** Phantom carrier for the key type; never present at runtime. */
31	  readonly __key?: K
32	}
33	
34	/** Static declaration of one domain: identity, version, and record layout. */
35	export interface DomainSpec {
36	  /** Domain name; must match `UNIT_NAME_RE` (doubles as the backend unit name). */
37	  readonly name: string
38	  /** Current domain format version; reads enforce it according to the selected layout. */
39	  readonly version: number
40	  /**
41	   * Medium layout for the backend unit: `single` (the default) stores the
42	   * whole unit as one document; `per-record` stores each record as its own
43	   * document, for units whose records are large, sparse, or individually
44	   * disposable — the projection cache — and scopes version checks per record
45	   * (an unaccepted record document is discarded, never migrated).
46	   */
47	  readonly layout?: 'single' | 'per-record'
48	  /**
49	   * Older domain versions whose stored records the current record schemas
50	   * also accept (the declaring owner vouches for that, typically by
51	   * declaring the fields older records lack as optional). `per-record` backends
52	   * read documents stamped with a listed version instead of discarding them,
53	   * and accept a legacy whole-unit file so stamped for the one-time
54	   * bootstrap; writes always stamp {@link version}.
55	   */
56	  readonly compatibleVersions?: readonly number[]
57	  /**
58	   * What `open` does with a stored table record that fails its zod schema.
59	   * Absent (the default), the whole open rejects with `invalid-record` —
60	   * right for authoritative data. `'backup-and-skip'` is for domains whose
61	   * records are disposable derived data: the backend moves the record's
62	   * document aside (`KvUnit.backupRecord`), the failure is logged with
63	   * its cause, and the open continues with the record absent. A backend
64	   * without `backupRecord` (no per-record document to move) falls back
65	   * to the rejecting default. The global slot always rejects.
66	   */
67	  readonly invalidRecords?: 'backup-and-skip'
68	  /** Optional global singleton slot. */
69	  readonly global?: DomainGlobalSpec<unknown>
70	  /** Table declarations keyed by table name; each name must match `UNIT_NAME_RE`. */
71	  readonly tables: Record<string, DomainTableSpec>
72	}

1	/**
2	 * Domain declaration vocabulary. A spec object is the single source of a
3	 * domain's identity, layout, and record schemas: the owning package defines
4	 * it once with {@link defineDomain} and both the type surface and the runtime
5	 * (validation, descriptor projection) derive from it. Record schemas are zod
6	 * (`z.infer` keeps types un-duplicated and the same schemas later project to
7	 * RPC wire schemas); plugin `Config` stays schemastery.
8	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain/src/spec
9	 */
10	
11	import type { ZodType } from 'zod'
12	import { UNIT_NAME_RE, type KvUnitDescriptor } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
13	
14	/** Global singleton declaration: schema plus the value used before the first write. */
15	export interface DomainGlobalSpec<G> {
16	  /** Validates the stored global at the durable boundary. */
17	  readonly schema: ZodType<G>
18	  /** Value served when the medium holds no global yet; not written until the first `set`. */
19	  readonly initial: G
20	}
21	
22	/**
23	 * One table declaration. `K` is a phantom key type (typically a branded
24	 * string) carried for compile-time projection only; keys are plain strings on
25	 * the medium.
26	 */
27	export interface DomainTableSpec<K extends string = string, V = unknown> {
28	  /** Validates every stored record at the durable boundary. */
29	  readonly valueSchema: ZodType<V>
30	  /** Phantom carrier for the key type; never present at runtime. */
31	  readonly __key?: K
32	}
33	
34	/** Static declaration of one domain: identity, version, and record layout. */
35	export interface DomainSpec {
36	  /** Domain name; must match `UNIT_NAME_RE` (doubles as the backend unit name). */
37	  readonly name: string
38	  /** Current domain format version; reads enforce it according to the selected layout. */
39	  readonly version: number
40	  /**
41	   * Medium layout for the backend unit: `single` (the default) stores the
42	   * whole unit as one document; `per-record` stores each record as its own
43	   * document, for units whose records are large, sparse, or individually
44	   * disposable — the projection cache — and scopes version checks per record
45	   * (an unaccepted record document is discarded, never migrated).
46	   */
47	  readonly layout?: 'single' | 'per-record'
48	  /**
49	   * Older domain versions whose stored records the current record schemas
50	   * also accept (the declaring owner vouches for that, typically by
51	   * declaring the fields older records lack as optional). `per-record` backends
52	   * read documents stamped with a listed version instead of discarding them,
53	   * and accept a legacy whole-unit file so stamped for the one-time
54	   * bootstrap; writes always stamp {@link version}.
55	   */
56	  readonly compatibleVersions?: readonly number[]
57	  /**
58	   * What `open` does with a stored table record that fails its zod schema.
59	   * Absent (the default), the whole open rejects with `invalid-record` —
60	   * right for authoritative data. `'backup-and-skip'` is for domains whose
61	   * records are disposable derived data: the backend moves the record's
62	   * document aside (`KvUnit.backupRecord`), the failure is logged with
63	   * its cause, and the open continues with the record absent. A backend
64	   * without `backupRecord` (no per-record document to move) falls back
65	   * to the rejecting default. The global slot always rejects.
66	   */
67	  readonly invalidRecords?: 'backup-and-skip'
68	  /** Optional global singleton slot. */
69	  readonly global?: DomainGlobalSpec<unknown>
70	  /** Table declarations keyed by table name; each name must match `UNIT_NAME_RE`. */
71	  readonly tables: Record<string, DomainTableSpec>
72	}
73	
74	/** Key type of one declared table, recovered from its phantom carrier. */
75	export type TableKeyOf<S extends DomainSpec, N extends keyof S['tables']> =
76	  S['tables'][N] extends DomainTableSpec<infer K> ? K : never
77	
78	/** Value type of one declared table. */
79	export type TableValueOf<S extends DomainSpec, N extends keyof S['tables']> =
80	  S['tables'][N] extends DomainTableSpec<string, infer V> ? V : never
81	
82	/** Global value type of a spec; `never` when the spec declares no global. */
83	export type GlobalValueOf<S extends DomainSpec> =
84	  S['global'] extends DomainGlobalSpec<infer G> ? G : never
85	
86	/**
87	 * Declare one table.
88	 * @param schema - zod schema validating every stored record of this table.
89	 * @returns the table declaration, key-typed by `K`.
90	 */
91	export function domainTable<K extends string, V>(schema: ZodType<V>): DomainTableSpec<K, V> {
92	  return { valueSchema: schema }
93	}
94	
95	/**
96	 * Identity helper that pins a spec's literal types and validates its fields.
97	 * Misconfiguration fails loud at the owning package's module load, before any
98	 * medium is touched: a domain or table name outside `UNIT_NAME_RE`, a version
99	 * that is not a non-negative integer, or a global schema that accepts `null`

1	// Offline, read-only Session trace context provider for team-member iteration
2	// analysis (evaluation evidence navigator — evidence, never conclusions).
3	//
4	// Scope is deliberately narrow: the current team's own `agent-team-*` member
5	// sessions under the adjacent checkouts, addressed by member handle. It is not
6	// a general-purpose session finder.
7	//
8	// Commands:
9	//   list                 member sessions with lightweight activity facts
10	//   timeline <member>    bounded lightweight event index (no bodies)
11	//   read <member> <seq>  bounded raw-event window around one seq
12	//   event <member> <seq> exact canonical payload of one event
13	//
14	// All reads go through the Harness composition (SessionStore + JSONL
15	// persistence + session-query exact reads), so packed-chunk decoding, seq
16	// continuity, replay validation, and surface classification all come from the
17	// same authority as the live runtime. No FTS backend is mounted; no session is
18	// made live; nothing is written.
19	//
20	// Usage: node --import tsx scripts/session-trace.ts <command> [options]
21	import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
22	import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
23	import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
24	import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
25	import SessionStore from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
26	import JsonlSessionPersistence from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl'
27	import SessionQueryEngine from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query'
28	import { harnessDir } from './harness-dir.mjs'
29	
30	const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_LIMIT = 200
31	const MAX_WINDOW = 50
32	const RECENT_ACTIVITY_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
33	const PROJECT_ROOT = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..')
34	/** This repo and the adjacent harness checkout — where this team's member
35	 * sessions actually run. Everything else (older experiments on other cwds)
36	 * stays out of the default view; `--all` lifts the filter. */
37	const TEAM_CWDS = [PROJECT_ROOT, harnessDir] as const
38	
39	function parseArgs(argv: readonly string[]): { command: string; positional: string[]; flags: Set<string>; values: Map<string, string> } {
40	  const [command = '', ...rest] = argv
41	  const positional: string[] = []
42	  const flags = new Set<string>()
43	  const values = new Map<string, string>()
44	  for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i++) {
45	    const arg = rest[i]!
46	    if (arg.startsWith('--')) {
47	      const eq = arg.indexOf('=')
48	      if (eq > 0) {
49	        values.set(arg.slice(2, eq), arg.slice(eq + 1))
50	        continue
51	      }
52	      const name = arg.slice(2)
53	      const next = rest[i + 1]
54	      if (next !== undefined && !next.startsWith('--')) {
55	        values.set(name, next)
56	        i++
57	      } else {
58	        flags.add(name)
59	      }
60	    } else {
61	      positional.push(arg)
62	    }
63	  }
64	  return { command, positional, flags, values }
65	}
66	
67	function usage(): never {
68	  console.log(`usage: session-trace.ts <command>
69	
70	commands:
71	  list [filters]                     member sessions with lightweight facts
72	  timeline <member> [filters]        bounded event index (no bodies)
73	  read <member> <seq> [--before N] [--after N]
74	                                      bounded raw window around one seq
75	  event <member> <seq>               exact canonical payload of one event
76	
77	common options:
78	  --all                list: include members with no recent activity
79	  --limit N            timeline: max rows (default ${DEFAULT_TIMELINE_LIMIT})
80	  --from-seq N / --to-seq N   timeline seq range
81	  --type T[,T...]      timeline: event type filter (e.g. tool/call)
82	  --tool NAME          timeline: derived toolName filter (team_ prefix allowed)
83	  --before N/--after N read window sizes (default 3, max ${MAX_WINDOW})
84	  --json               emit structured JSON (default is a human-readable table;
85	                       read/event always emit JSON — they are raw payloads)
86	  --home PATH          DSH home (default ~/.dsh)`)
87	  process.exit(1)
88	}
89	
90	interface MemberAddress { handle: string; sessionId: string }
91	
92	/**
93	 * Resolve the current team's members from the ledger, keeping only the
94	 * workspace that holds this repo's members. The ledger is used strictly as an
95	 * address book (handle → sessionId); no projection semantics are interpreted.
96	 * Historical experiment members on other workspaces stay out of the output.
97	 */
98	function readMemberAddresses(dshHome: string): MemberAddress[] {
99	  const db = new DatabaseSync(`${dshHome}/storages/agent_team.sqlite`, { readOnly: true })
100	  try {
101	    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT value FROM u_agent_team_operations').all() as { value: string }[]
102	    const members = new Map<string, { memberId: string; workspaceId: string; handle: string; sessionId: string; state: string }>()
103	    for (const row of rows) {
104	      const op = JSON.parse(row.value) as {
105	        kind: string
106	        data?: { member?: { memberId: string; workspaceId: string; handle: string; sessionId: string; state: string } }
107	      }
108	      const member = op.data?.member
109	      if (member === undefined) continue
110	      switch (op.kind) {
111	        case 'team/member-added':
112	        case 'team/member-updated':
113	        case 'team/member-session-renewed':
114	        case 'team/member-session-rolled-over':
115	        case 'team/member-session-recycled':
116	        case 'team/member-resumed':
117	          members.set(member.memberId, member)
118	          break
119	        case 'team/member-removed':
120	          members.delete(member.memberId)
121	          break
122	      }
123	    }
124	    const enabled = [...members.values()].filter(m => m.state === 'enabled')
125	    const workspaceCounts = new Map<string, number>()
126	    for (const member of enabled) {
127	      workspaceCounts.set(member.workspaceId, (workspaceCounts.get(member.workspaceId) ?? 0) + 1)

39	function parseArgs(argv: readonly string[]): { command: string; positional: string[]; flags: Set<string>; values: Map<string, string> } {
40	  const [command = '', ...rest] = argv
41	  const positional: string[] = []
42	  const flags = new Set<string>()
43	  const values = new Map<string, string>()
44	  for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i++) {
45	    const arg = rest[i]!
46	    if (arg.startsWith('--')) {
47	      const eq = arg.indexOf('=')
48	      if (eq > 0) {
49	        values.set(arg.slice(2, eq), arg.slice(eq + 1))
50	        continue
51	      }
52	      const name = arg.slice(2)
53	      const next = rest[i + 1]
54	      if (next !== undefined && !next.startsWith('--')) {
55	        values.set(name, next)
56	        i++
57	      } else {
58	        flags.add(name)
59	      }
60	    } else {
61	      positional.push(arg)
62	    }
63	  }
64	  return { command, positional, flags, values }
65	}

98	function readMemberAddresses(dshHome: string): MemberAddress[] {
99	  const db = new DatabaseSync(`${dshHome}/storages/agent_team.sqlite`, { readOnly: true })
100	  try {
101	    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT value FROM u_agent_team_operations').all() as { value: string }[]
102	    const members = new Map<string, { memberId: string; workspaceId: string; handle: string; sessionId: string; state: string }>()
103	    for (const row of rows) {
104	      const op = JSON.parse(row.value) as {
105	        kind: string
106	        data?: { member?: { memberId: string; workspaceId: string; handle: string; sessionId: string; state: string } }
107	      }
108	      const member = op.data?.member
109	      if (member === undefined) continue
110	      switch (op.kind) {
111	        case 'team/member-added':
112	        case 'team/member-updated':
113	        case 'team/member-session-renewed':
114	        case 'team/member-session-rolled-over':
115	        case 'team/member-session-recycled':
116	        case 'team/member-resumed':
117	          members.set(member.memberId, member)
118	          break
119	        case 'team/member-removed':
120	          members.delete(member.memberId)
121	          break
122	      }
123	    }
124	    const enabled = [...members.values()].filter(m => m.state === 'enabled')
125	    const workspaceCounts = new Map<string, number>()
126	    for (const member of enabled) {
127	      workspaceCounts.set(member.workspaceId, (workspaceCounts.get(member.workspaceId) ?? 0) + 1)
128	    }
129	    let currentWorkspace: string | undefined
130	    let currentCount = 0
131	    for (const [workspaceId, count] of workspaceCounts) {
132	      if (count > currentCount) {
133	        currentWorkspace = workspaceId
134	        currentCount = count
135	      }
136	    }
137	    return enabled
138	      .filter(m => m.workspaceId === currentWorkspace)
139	      .map(m => ({ handle: m.handle, sessionId: m.sessionId }))
140	  } finally {
141	    db.close()
142	  }
143	}

121	### 3.4 Inbox 行与等级
122	
123	Inbox 是一个函数，Human 与 Agent 共用：
124	
125	| 行 | 来源 | direct 计数 | ordinary 计数 |
126	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
127	| Thread 行 | Attention unread + Thread direct / activity markers | markers | Attention unread |
128	| Main stream 行（每 Project 一行） | §3.3 | Main stream markers | owner 的 Main stream unread |
129	
130	Human UI 以 direct（蓝点）/ ordinary（白点）渲染；Agent 的 `team_inbox` 渲染同样的两个计数。
131	
132	### 3.5 Delivery class（运行时计算，不落盘）
133	
134	对 Agent recipient 的每个未读 fact：
135	
136	```text
137	Thread direct / activity marker、Main stream marker、reminder → immediate
138	Main stream ordinary（recipient 是 owner，含新讨论 Thread）  → immediate
139	Thread ordinary，recipient 是该 Project owner 或该 Task accountable → threshold
140	Thread ordinary，其余 follower                              → immediate
141	```
142	
143	- threshold：按 `recipient × thread` 统计未投递的 ordinary 数，达到 5 时注入一次 bounded summary；不足 5 时随下一次 immediate notice 以摘要带出。
144	- “已摘要到哪个 sequence”是运行时状态（与现有 `covered` 签名同层）；Host 重启后同一批可能再摘要一次，符合 at-least-once。
145	- `covered` 签名纳入 delivery class 与 source kind，避免 threshold summary 与 immediate notice 互相覆盖。
146	
147	### 3.6 Task board
148	
149	```text
150	taskBoard(member, filter?) = 对 member 可见的每个 Project 的 open Task：
151	  status、accountable、active Claim owners、sourceThreadRefs、最近活动时刻、
152	  member 与它的关系（accountable / executor / project-owner / none）
153	filter：projectRef；mine（accountable 或 executor）
154	done/closed：每 Project 最近 5 条
155	```
156	
157	Human 看板与 `team_task board` 读同一投影。`team_view` 的 `active task threads` 段删除。
158	
159	### 3.7 Task 卡片位置（UI 与 tool 渲染共用）
160	
161	- `sourceThreadRefs` 非空：每个来源 Thread 中、在 Task 创建 sequence 处一张卡片。
162	- `sourceThreadRefs` 为空：Main stream 中一张卡片。
163	- 卡片显示当前 status 与 accountable，不是 fact，不进入 unread。
164	
165	## 4. Remote（Human Client）
166	
167	| Remote | 说明 |
168	| --- | --- |
169	| `createProject` / `updateProject` / `archiveProject` | 原 Channel 三件套改名 |
170	| `addProjectOwner` / `removeProjectOwner` | 新增 |
171	| `postMainMessage` / `readMainStream` / `mainStreamHistory` | 新增；`readMainStream` 写 `main-stream-read` |
172	| `startThread` | 取代顶层 `sendMessage`；`kind: 'discussion' \| 'task'`，task 时可带 `accountable`、`sourceThreadRefs` |
173	| `reply` / `readThread` / `threadHistory` / `changeAttention` | 删除确认 token 参数与流程 |
174	| `changeTask` / `promoteThread` / `transferTask` | `transferTask` 新增 |
175	| `taskBoard` | 新增，取代 Client 从 feed 窗口推算 |
176	| `inbox` | 行增加 Main stream 行 |
177	| `changes` | scope 增加 Main stream |

# Collaboration model and time

English | [中文](model-and-time.zh.md)

## Collaboration model
A top-level Project Message creates one Thread and anchor. New model-facing starts are taskless by default; explicit task intent creates a Task overlay atomically, while an omitted field remains taskful for released Clients. A Human can promote a taskless Thread with one atomic Task activity. Replies append immutable Messages. Public Thread chronology consists of Messages and, only with a Task overlay, Claim changes, Human resolution, and promotion.

Agents may read or mutate only Projects in Workspaces they participate in. Tools resolve the actor from the exact live Agent; the model cannot choose an actor. The `workspace` selector must name a participated Workspace — an exact id, or a unique prefix of at least 6 hex characters, the same tolerance the branded refs have. A prefix matching several Workspaces is refused by naming every candidate.

The selector can be omitted for a single participation. With multiple participations it is required on `team_view`, `team_thread`, `team_message`, and `team_task`, and rejection lists the available Workspace ids.

`team_inbox` instead merges all participations by default, with `workspace` as an optional filter applied before sorting and truncation. Inbox rows and notification details identify their source Workspace; `team_thread` renders Workspace/Project provenance before the outcome line. Multi-Workspace guidance supplies paths, the `working_directory` rule and per-checkout `AGENTS.md` pointers.

Joining does not change Session cwd; entering a joined Workspace does, through `working_directory({cd})`, and that change is what makes the checkout's instructions load.

## Member time awareness
Every agent-facing collaboration surface carries absolute event instants; sequence and revision — never wall-clock time — remain the sole ordering and concurrency authority. Ledger storage keeps UTC ISO `occurredAt` on every operation; rendering converts through one fixed-offset formatter into the Team coordination zone UTC+8 with an explicit offset (`2026-09-08T17:00:00+08:00`).

The fixed offset has no daylight-saving component, so the same stored instant renders byte-identically on every reread path (read, history paging, post-compaction rebuild, old-ledger replay) — the context-cache invariant. Only absolute timestamps are rendered; relative time text ("3 hours ago") never appears in durable facts. A future configuration layer may make the zone configurable; until then one deterministic formatter per stored instant is the contract, and the Web Client keeps its own browser-local rendering.

- `team_thread` read/history facts and the anchor carry their committing operation's instant on the fact envelope (message and activity alike — activities have no instant of their own). Fact lines render `sequence instant [sender] body`; the anchor renders `Anchor sequence instant [sender]`.
- `team_inbox` rows carry `newestOccurredAt` — the instant of the newest unread fact, taken from the same snapshot as `newestSequence`.
- `team_view` Thread rows carry `lastActivityAt`, projected from the Thread's tail fact.
- Automatic notifications state `Occurred at:` on direct mentions and activities, and the newest ordinary unread instant on body-free routes.
- DM relays state the sending instant; the prior-DM context line cites that DM's instant.
- Committed mutations (`team_message` start/reply/dm, `team_task`) render `Committed at:` from the operation receipt; optimistic Client merges read the same receipt instant.
- Ledgers written before fact-envelope instants existed normalize on replay: the instant is re-derived from the committing operation, never fabricated.

Besides event instants, the first model step of every eligible Team Member turn receives one durable clock snapshot (the `member-time-context` preset row): the current instant in UTC+8, the elapsed time since the preceding model-visible event, and the ordering-authority note.

Later steps of the same turn stay quiet unless the turn has run longer than the refresh interval since the last landed snapshot. When it has, one snapshot lands per elapsed interval — a tool-dense turn of quick steps produces exactly one line, while a turn that outlives the interval still shows its real span. Skipped steps never backfill, and their span folds into the next snapshot's elapsed. The default interval is 30 minutes, overridable through the preset row's plugin config for a future configuration layer to take over.

The baseline folds from the Member Session's own events, so restart, resume, and compaction derive identical values without a second store; a generation swap starts a fresh log and renders elapsed as `unavailable` rather than guessing across generations; a wall-clock rollback clamps elapsed to `0s` without rewriting history. The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` stays unmounted because its browser-zone policy would ask background-woken Members to confirm dates with an absent user.

Time conditions are evaluated only when Team events occur: a ledger commit, Member activation, an Inbox read, or an existing wake. The Host owns no reminder timer, deadline, scheduler, SLA, or staleness-driven state change. A completely silent Team therefore does not wake itself merely because a threshold passed.

Two private Task reminders exist. A Task in `in_review` reminds its eligible verifier after the Agent has been observably idle for 30 minutes. For a Human verifier, the condition is instead 30 minutes after entering review.

A Task in `in_progress` reminds its accountable owner after 24 hours without public Thread progress. It also reminds when an active Claim owner has been observably idle for more than 24 hours. Agent idle is process-local and survives generation replacement; after a Host restart an unknown idle interval is skipped rather than inferred from an old Session log.

Each `team/reminder-raised` operation is durable and private to its recipient, keyed by Task, kind, recipient, and condition baseline. It is not a public Thread fact, does not change revision or restart a stalled baseline, and is consumed only by reading that Task Thread.

An existing unread responsibility event suppresses a duplicate nudge without consuming the episode. The first deployment may raise one reminder for each already-eligible historical episode on its next Team event.

# 协作模型与时间感知

[English](model-and-time.md) | 中文

## 协作模型
Project 顶层 Message 会创建一个 Thread 及其 anchor。新的 model-facing start 默认创建 taskless Thread。传入明确的 task intent 会在同一个 atomic operation 中创建 Task overlay。省略字段则为 released Clients 保留 taskful 行为。Human 可以随后 promotion 一个 taskless Thread。一次 atomic operation 创建 Task overlay，并记一条结构化 `promote` Task activity。Activity 会通知当前 followers。promotion 不写 prose Message。Reply 会向既有 Thread 添加 immutable Messages。公开 Thread facts 包括 Messages。仅在存在 Task overlay 时，才有 Claim changes、Human Task resolution changes 和 promotion。它们的 global operation sequence 决定 chronology 与当前 Thread revision。

Agent 只能读取或修改其已参与 Workspace 中的 Projects。Team tools 从确切的 live Agent 解析 actor，模型不能选择 actor。`workspace` 选择器必须指向一个已参与的 Workspace——接受完整 id，或至少 6 位十六进制的唯一前缀（与 branded refs 同一套容忍度）；前缀匹配到多个 Workspace 时拒绝并列出全部候选。单一参与时可省略。多参与时在 `team_view`、`team_thread`、`team_message`、`team_task` 上必填。拒绝信息列出可选 Workspace id。`team_inbox` 则默认合并全部参与，`workspace` 仅作为排序与截断前的可选过滤。Inbox 行与通知详情标注来源 Workspace。`team_thread` 在结果行前渲染 Workspace/Project 来源。多 Workspace 引导提供路径、`working_directory` 规则与每个 checkout 的 `AGENTS.md` 指针。

加入不改变 Session cwd；进入已加入的 Workspace 会改变它（`working_directory({cd})`），而正是这次改变让该 checkout 的指令被加载。

## Member 时间感知
所有 agent-facing 协作表面都携带绝对事件时刻。sequence 与 revision（绝非 wall-clock 时间）仍是唯一的顺序与并发 authority。Ledger 存储在每个 operation 上保留 UTC ISO 的 `occurredAt`。渲染通过唯一的固定偏移 formatter 换算为 Team 协调时区 UTC+8 并带显式偏移（`2026-09-08T17:00:00+08:00`）。固定偏移没有夏令时分量。同一存储时刻在任何重读路径中渲染完全一致：read、history 翻页、compaction 后重建、旧 ledger replay。这就是 context-cache 不变量。只渲染绝对 timestamp。durable facts 中绝不出现相对时间文案（「3 小时前」）。未来的配置层可以让时区可配置。在那之前合同是：每个存储时刻对应一个确定性 formatter。Web Client 保持自己的浏览器本地渲染。

- `team_thread` read/history 的 facts 与 anchor 带有时刻。时刻在 fact envelope 上，来自各自的提交 operation。Message 与 Activity 一致。Activity 自身没有时刻，从承载 operation 投影。fact 行渲染为 `sequence 时刻 [sender] 正文`。anchor 渲染为 `Anchor sequence 时刻 [sender]`。
- `team_inbox` 行携带 `newestOccurredAt`——最新 unread fact 的时刻，与 `newestSequence` 取自同一快照。
- `team_view` 的 Thread 行携带 `lastActivityAt`，从该 Thread 的尾部 fact 投影。
- 自动通知在 direct mention 与 activity 上给出 `Occurred at:`。无正文路由给出最新 ordinary unread 时刻。
- DM relay 给出发送时刻；prior-DM 上下文行引用那条 DM 的时刻。
- 已提交的变更（`team_message` start/reply/dm、`team_task`）从 operation receipt 渲染 `Committed at:`。Client 的乐观合并读取同一 receipt 时刻。
- fact envelope 时刻出现之前写入的 ledgers 在 replay 时 normalize。时刻从提交 operation 重新派生，绝不凭空制造。

除事件时刻外，还有 durable clock snapshot（`member-time-context` preset row）。每个符合条件的 Team Member turn 的首个 model step 会收到一条。snapshot 有三样东西。第一，UTC+8 的当前时刻。第二，距上一个 model-visible event 的 elapsed。第三，ordering-authority 说明。 同一 turn 的后续 step 默认保持安静。只有距上一条落盘 snapshot 已超过 refresh interval，才再注入一条。快速 step 的 tool-dense turn 恰好产出一行，超出 interval 的 turn 仍能显示真实跨度。

被跳过的 step 绝不回填。它们的时间跨度折叠进下一条 snapshot 的 elapsed。 默认 interval 为 30 分钟。preset row 的 plugin config 可覆盖它，留给未来的配置层接管。 baseline 从该 Member Session 自身事件折叠而来。restart、resume 和 compaction 无需第二存储即可派生出相同值。换代开启全新日志，elapsed 渲染为 `unavailable` 而不是跨代猜测。wall-clock 回拨将 elapsed 夹为 `0s` 而不改写历史。

内置的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` 保持不挂载，因为 browser-zone 策略会让后台唤醒的 Member 向不存在的用户确认日期。

时间条件只在 Team 事件发生时评估：ledger 提交、Member activation、Inbox read 或已有 wake。Host 不拥有 reminder timer、deadline、scheduler、SLA，也不会按陈旧度自动改变 Task 状态。整个 Team 完全静默时，不会仅因阈值到点而自行唤醒。

现有两类私有 Task 提醒。`in_review` 的 Task 在有验收资格的 Agent 可确认 idle 达 30 分钟后提醒它；验收者是 Human 时，以进入待验收满 30 分钟为条件。

`in_progress` 的 Task 在公开 Thread 24 小时没有进展，或 active Claim 持有者可确认 idle 超过 24 小时时，提醒 accountable owner。Agent idle 是进程内观测，跨 generation 替换延续；Host 重启后 idle 未知则跳过，不从旧 Session 日志猜测。

每条 `team/reminder-raised` 都是 durable、仅接收者可见的记录，以 Task、类型、接收者和条件起点去重。它不是公开 Thread fact，不改变 revision，也不重置停滞起点；只有读取所属 Task Thread 才消费。

已有同一 Task 的未读责任事件时不重复催促，也不消耗 episode。首次部署后，下一次 Team 事件可能为已经达到条件的历史 episode 各补一条提醒。

A Project owner starts or promotes Threads; accountability is separate from execution and does not confer ownership. A Member can execute a Task without owning its Project.

| --- | --- | --- |

| Transfer an open Task | Yes | Current accountable |
| Transfer a finished Task | Yes | No |

An accountable Agent who held any Claim cannot accept that Task. An uninvolved Project owner or the Human must verify it; the accountable may instead transfer responsibility. A transfer target is an enabled Project owner or the Human, and Claims stay with their executors. # Mutation fences and boundaries

English | [中文](boundaries.zh.md)

## Mutation fences
Existing-Thread public mutations require the current next-write token in `baseRevision` — an opaque copy-through value, not a fact about the Thread. The model copies the latest explicitly rendered value verbatim and never increments, derives, compares, or cites it. The token appears on exactly two surfaces: a `team_thread read` that leaves no unread remaining, and a committed public mutation (`team_message` start/reply, `team_task` mutation) whose result returns the resulting Thread state.

It is absent from `team_view`, `team_inbox`, `team_thread status/follow/unfollow/history`, `team_task list`, partial reads, and every typed rejection — a fresh-looking token there would invite a blind retry.

Host checks: (1) relevant unread must be read, otherwise `unread_required`; (2) the token must match the current Thread revision, otherwise `stale_revision`; (3) closed Tasks reject replies, Claims, and new Attention. Taskless Threads have no Claim or Task-resolution mutation. These are normal collaboration outcomes, not infrastructure failures; there is no force-send or unread bypass.

An exemption sits inside check (1) and only there. When every unread fact is already on the writer's model-visible surface in full, the write is allowed without a read — the notice that carried the body is itself the reading.

The exemption persists nothing: no attention watermark advances, no direct marker is consumed, and the durable "has this been read" answer stays exactly what it was. One fact off the surface keeps the write refused, and a Member with no live Session is never exempt. A rejected mutation still renders no bypass: it carries the facts that gated the write and the current revision to retry with, and recovery is read the Thread and reconsider.

Human close releases active Claims and ends Attention. Reopen restores an open Task but not previous Attention periods.

## Human Remote boundary
The Human Client uses `readThread`, `threadHistory`, `threadObservations`, `changeAttention`, and `changes`, and it consumes the Host's Human Inbox slice as the 「收件箱 / Inbox」 queue. That is one Inbox call per visible Workspace — the whole unread slice, `directCount` per row and `totalUnreadCount` for the badge — merged across Workspaces into the badge and the Inbox page.

That page renders the Host's two slices. The first is the unread queue 「需要我」, whose counts the badge and header totals describe. The second is the 「最近活跃」 tail of Threads the reader has written a Message in. A reply makes a Thread theirs whether or not they follow it, and so does a Thread they started that nobody has answered yet — a reply does not implicitly follow, so Attention decides what notifies a reader rather than what they took part in. That tail is newest activity first, each Workspace's slice bounded to ten and the merged page showing at most five, never a Thread the queue already holds.

Neither slice names an archived Project's Threads: archival ends participation as well as notification. An Agent's Inbox receives the queue alone. Opening the Inbox page acknowledges nothing — only a durable Thread read consumes a mention marker. `threadObservations` feeds the Thread composer's mention ranking (current followers first); the observation history itself stays unrendered. Browser storage keeps navigation mode, Workspace selection, and the Inbox page position (a navigation fact, not an unread fact); unread, Attention, revisions, and observations remain Host-owned.

The Client merges the per-Workspace Inbox calls in the Client; there is no home-level Inbox ledger or Remote.

## Team Member context boundary
The explicit `team-member` preset contains coding tools, background jobs, the skill loader tool, compaction, all seven Team tools, Workspace instruction discovery, and private-memory context. Harness `agent-instructions` remains the sole loader for `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`. Each Member private root has `memory.md`, `notes/`, and `skills/`; only a bounded 16 KiB escaped reference index is injected, and the block states its current usage as `X.X KiB / 16 KiB` with a percentage. Memory can be stale and never overrides Workspace instructions, Human input, or durable Team facts.

Do not store credentials, sensitive data, guesses, chat logs, or facts already owned by the ledger.

The Member's working directory is not a preset row: Harness mounts `working_directory` globally, outside every preset, and the Host unions it over any tool allow-list. A Member therefore enters a Workspace it has joined with `working_directory({cd})` instead of reaching into that checkout by absolute path, which is what loads the checkout's own `AGENTS.md`. Participation, Claims, and write permissions stay bound to the creation Workspace; only the directory moves.

The persona states the private-space physical facts (the injected absolute paths, never cwd-relative ones, the memory/notes discipline, and the reusable-assets boundary). It says nothing about managing context: the preset's engine compacts and the Host swaps a generation, so there is no instruction a Member could act on. Anything worth keeping across a generation belongs in private memory while the work happens, not in a farewell before it.

+| Accept | Any open Task | Project owner, only in `in_review`, and never held any Claim on the Task |

# Attention, mentions, and messages

English | [中文](attention-and-messaging.zh.md)

## Thread Attention and Inbox
Attention is durable private state for one Member and Thread: current period start and contiguous read watermark. Creating a Thread (its author follows), creating a Task Claim, or explicitly following starts it. Taskless Threads can be unfollowed directly; taskful Threads require no active Claim. Unfollow ends the period and discards its unread work; a later follow starts at the current tail.

While active, other Members' Messages—and taskful Claim and Task resolution Activities—become ordinary unread. Mentions create durable direct markers. The sender's own mutation is not unread. Promotion creates a `promote` Activity for current followers. Follow/unfollow/read are private and do not advance Thread revision.

The first read returns the anchor, optional Task/Claim snapshot, limited recent background, and bounded unread batch. Background is orientation and already read. `history` is the only older-facts pager, and a Member re-entering a Thread it has read before receives no background — its orientation there is the anchor and the batch alone, so the facts between are its own to page back to.

Human navigation is Workspace → Project → Thread; a Task is an overlay, not a navigation level. The Inbox is a global Team page that opens from the sidebar card/narrow-rail icon and merges every visible Workspace's Inbox calls — the reader's whole unread slice, mentions counted inside it rather than alone. Opening it performs no Thread read, and only opening a Thread advances the watermark and clears its direct and private reminder markers. A private Task reminder is a direct notification, not a mention or a public Activity; reading the Inbox or board never consumes it.

Opening a Thread performs durable Human read and scrolls to the latest fact; a bounded result with remaining unread drains automatically through continued reads, so no explicit continuation exists. History does not acknowledge new work. Arrivals while the Thread is open are acknowledged durably regardless of scroll position; a reader away from the bottom sees only a pure jump hint with no read semantics.

An Inbox call answers a bounded queue: at most `limit` unread Threads (1–100, default 50), with `hasMore` stating whether Threads remain beyond that page, and the Client prints that verdict where its list ends. Reading a Thread drains it from the queue, so the rows a full page hid become reachable without a cursor — which the projection deliberately does not carry.

## Mentions
A Message names its recipients in its own body: writing `@Handle` is what makes a mention, matched against the Project's addressable names case-insensitively, on Unicode word boundaries, and longest handle first, so a name the Client renders as a chip is the same name that delivers. A bare handle stays ordinary prose, and a handle inside a code block or code span is quoted rather than called. `@all` is plain text under rules version 2: it notifies no one, so every Member that must be reached is named.

No recipient parameter exists: the Host resolves the body for a Human composing in the Web Client and for an Agent composing through `team_message` alike. The Human is addressable the same way, as `@human` — a permanent alias that survives renames (the current display name from `team_view` addresses them too, and chips render that name either way). No agent handle may claim the `human` literal, so the alias never notifies anyone else.

A mention — in a Thread start, a reply, or a Main stream post — delivers its Message to the named Member once and never starts or resumes Attention: following is a Member's own explicit choice. Every addressable Member of the Project can be mentioned; there is no invitation step.

Agents may mention the Human without making the Human a follower.

A reply answers one existing Message, so it also carries that Message's author as a recipient: quoting a Member delivers to them exactly as naming them does.

The author joins the recipient set before delivery is resolved, under the same direct-marker rule, and the Human is never a recipient because they read the Thread directly. A Message's own author is never added to itself, so answering your own Message notifies nobody.

A reply whose target is unknown, or belongs to another Thread, is refused rather than recorded.

A direct-mention notice names the Message it carries and, when that Message answers another, the one it answers: `Message ref` is the Message being delivered, and `Replies to` is its parent. Without that line a recipient knows it was answered but not what it said, and the answer it sends back is a guess.

The line states the parent's author and the first line of its body, with the full ref last: `Replies to: @handle — "first line" [message:<uuid>]`. The ref is what the reader hands back — to `team_message.replyToMessageRef` to answer it, or to `team_thread message` to read the body whole. A parent that no longer resolves, which an archived Project causes, leaves the line as the bare ref: the ref is still true and a summary would not be.

## Human-readable messages
Every message leads with the conclusion or state; mechanical detail — `file:line`, commands, hashes, probe output — follows below it, and detail a peer Member needs is never dropped, only moved. Prose stays in the language the Human writes, while identifiers, paths, commands, and refs stay verbatim.

Mentioning the Human — writing `@human` in the body — is how the Human is notified; the mention creates the durable direct marker the Human Inbox surfaces, and nothing else does. The minimum set that mentions the Human: a Human decision is owed; a Claim is finished and waits for acceptance; a blocker or risk the Human must know about; progress the Human explicitly asked for. Mid-thread progress chatter between Agents stays Agent-to-Agent and mentions no Human. The persona states this contract and the `team_message` body description restates its opening rule where the model composes the body.

A mention opens with the answer in one to three readable sentences; when a decision is owed, it says plainly what needs deciding and what happens by default if nobody answers — no fixed template. Message shape is a convention the Inbox ignores: it counts mentions, never formatting.

## Ref citation
Team tools return branded refs (`task:`, `thread:`, `project:`, `member:`, `claim:`) with full UUIDs; reuse them verbatim when quoting. A ref whose UUID is truncated still resolves when its first 6+ hex characters are unambiguous: `task:0f0ad7` addresses the Task whose UUID starts with `0f0ad7`. A prefix shared by several refs is rejected with the candidate full refs, and a prefix shorter than 6 hex characters is not accepted — lengthen the prefix or quote the full ref.

Abbreviated refs obey the same boundaries as full refs: Tasks and Threads under archived Projects stay unreachable, and the Client renders a ref as a link only when it resolves uniquely, leaving unresolvable text plain.

# dsh-agent-team 领域词汇

[English](domain-model.md) | 中文

## Agent Team

一个 dshHome 内唯一的共享协作域。Agent Team 保存跨 Member 的协作事实；Member 的模型上下文、session transcript、私有记忆都不在共享之列。

## Member

Agent Team 中可被授权读取、发言、认领并接收 Inbox 提示的稳定身份，Member 以不可变的 member ref 标识。私有记忆、skills、persona 与 model 是 Member 一级的全局事实，不按 workspace 存放。首版有 Human Member 和 Agent Member 两类。

## Workspace Participation

Member 与 workspace 之间是可 join、可 leave 的关系。每次变动都以 ledger operation 提交。它与 project 参与关系是同一种关系形状，位置在其上一级。层级是 workspace participation → project 参与（由 Thread 派生）→ Thread Attention。Member 的 `workspaceId` 只记录创建地、永不改变。一切授权只看当前参与集合，不看创建字段。加入带来协作能力，但不移动也不创建 Member 的 session。当前每个 Member 只有创建 Workspace 下的一条 Session 血统。新增参与不创建另一条 Session；Member 用 `working_directory` 把自己的工作目录切进去。Member 在其他已参与的 Workspace 中同样可以发言、认领和回复。Human Member 参与每个 workspace。

## Human Member

对应当前 Harness 用户的特殊 Member。Human Member 参与消息、claim 与 activity。它拥有 project、Member、验收和 task 终态的管理权限。

## Agent Member

由 Agent Team 创建和管理的 Member。Member 在某个 workspace 中创建。这个 workspace 就是 Member 创建记录所载之处。之后通过 Workspace Participation 加入更多 workspace。本轮 Member 仍只运行一个 live Session。它扎根于创建 workspace。按参与切分 Session 血统（每个 workspace 一条、可切换）是后续工作。普通 session 与 fork 不自动获得成员身份。

## Member Capabilities

写在 Member 实体上的持久能力意图（可选 `capabilities` 字段：`tools.allow` 与 `skills.allow`），随全部 lifecycle operation 原样流转，Host restart 后重放恢复。它只是意图（intent）：allow-list 里的名字在 commit 时不做白名单校验。Harness 升级改名或删除工具，都不能让旧 ledger 失去重放能力。与当时已知名字的偏差，在 activation 时变成 runtime warning（`capabilityWarnings`，由投影派生、不持久化：持久化的 warning 会在 Host 重启或升级后失真）。

## Workspace

共享工作目录与授权域。Agent Member 的 session header cwd 是创建 Workspace 的目录，永不改变；它实际工作的目录属于 Session 自己，可通过 `working_directory` 切换。Member 私有记忆不存放在 Workspace 目录中。

## Project

Workspace 内的持久协作场所。Member 通过在 Project 的任一 Thread 里参与（读取、发言、认领或 follow）而参与该 Project，这也正是它在 Project 内一切动作的授权来源；不存在需要另行授予的加入关系。Human Member 可以查看 Workspace 内全部 Project。

ledger 采用规则版本 2 之后，Project 有 owner：Human 恒为每个 Project 的 owner 且不存储；Agent owner 由 Human 增删（`team/project-owner-added` / `team/project-owner-removed`），目标须参与该 Project 所在 Workspace 且为 enabled 或 suspended。离开该 Workspace、归档或删除会结束 Agent 的 owner 身份，暂停不会。

从版本 2 起，Project membership 还包括 owner 和曾在该 Project 被 mention 的 Member，并排除 archived 与 inactive 的 Member；版本 1 下可见的一切仍然可见。

规则版本 2 起，每个 Project 还有独立于所有 Thread 的 Main stream。任何 Project member 都可以发言（`team/main-message-posted`）。Main stream Message 带 `scope: 'main'`，没有 Thread 或 Task，回复目标只能是同一 Project 的另一条 Main stream Message。点名某个 Member 或回复其 Message（Human 也算）会给对方一个 Main stream marker；`@all` 只是普通文本。

owner 的 Main stream 未读是其成为 owner 之后、已读 watermark 之后其他 Member 写下的 Message、owner 变更和新的讨论 Thread，再加上它的 marker；Human 的起点取 Project 创建与版本 2 采用二者中较晚者。非 owner 只有 marker；Agent 不再是 owner 时保留 marker，失去普通未读。

持有 Main stream 未读的写入者先读（`main_unread_required`）。`team/main-stream-read` 推进 owner 的 watermark 并消费 marker，两者都不变时不写入。

规则版本 2 起，只有 Project owner 能开 Thread（`team/thread-started`，kind 为 `discussion` 或 `task`），顶层 `team/message-sent` 不再写入；其他人得到 `project_owner_required`，并被指向 Main stream。

Thread 在 Main stream 以卡片出现，显示其当前状态：讨论显示 anchor 预览、回复数、发言者和最新活动；Task 显示编号、状态和活 Claim owner。版本 1 的顶层 Thread 按创建顺序显示为卡片，且永不未读。

规则版本 2 起，任何 Project member 都可在任意 Thread 回复。点名或回复指向只产生一个 direct marker，不开始也不恢复 Attention，Human 邀请确认流程不再存在。

## Message

Member 在 Project 或已有 Thread 中显式发出的不可变内容。Project 顶层每条 Message 原子地创建一个 Thread。新 Client/tool 默认创建 taskless Thread，只有显式选择「作为任务」，同一次提交才会附带真实 Task。Thread Message 只延续已有 Thread。每条 Message 携带提交 operation 的 wall-clock 时刻；agent-facing 表面在固定的 UTC+8 协调时区下渲染该时刻。

## Task

贴在既有 Thread 上的一层可选 work-tracking overlay——Thread 不靠它存在。它的原子创建有两种：顶层 Message 的显式「作为任务」意图，或 Human promotion 的后附。promotion 同时追加一条公开说明 Message。 Task 的工作状态从 Claims 派生。Human acceptance 与 closed 是显式覆盖事实。常规验收要全部 Claim 完成（in_review）。Human 也可在 in_progress 时提前验收。accept 会把当时仍 active 的 Claims 投影为 done，并在 activity 里记下 `completedClaimRefs`。owner 各自收到通知。它不伪造 owner 的 claim-done 事件。从未被 claim 的 todo Task 也能直接验收。activity 里没有 claim 列表，账目上如实记为无 Claim 完成。 面向 Human 的 `Task #N` 是 Task 在 home Project 内的 durable 创建序号。taskful 顶层发送和后续 promotion 均参与排序。taskless anchor 最初在时间线的位置不参与。既有 ledger 的编号保持不变。

它不是稳定身份；跨 Project 导航和持久引用必须使用 branded `taskRef`。

## Thread

Project 内独立的单层公开协作 aggregate：一定有 `threadRef`、anchor Message 和 revision，但可以没有 Task。Thread revision 随公开 Message 递增，Taskful Thread 的 Claim 变化和 Task resolution 也一样。往既有 Thread 公开写入时，必须带上该 Thread 的当前 revision。taskless Thread 仍支持 reply、follow、structured mention、Inbox、read 与 history，但没有 Claims、Task status 或 accept/close/reopen。协作读写定位优先用 `threadRef`。released task-only Client 可把 `taskRef` 用作仅限 taskful Thread 的 Host compatibility alias。Task/Claim 操作的身份仍是 `taskRef`。revision 是内部并发令牌，只在工具 baseRevision 里透传，不写进消息正文当引用事实。

## Direct Message

Member 之间的私有直达消息，不属于 Thread。ledger 只追加一条 audit-only 的 `team/dm-sent` operation。requestId 幂等，sender/recipient 必须是同 Workspace 的 enabled Agent Member。projection 有意不变：不产生 Project、Thread、revision、Attention 或 Inbox markers。送达是运行时的瞬时效果。收件人 idle 时以 relay-form user message 开一个 followup turn，busy 时 steer 进当前 turn。正文里带一行有界的相邻上下文（紧邻上一条往来 DM 的摘要）。注入失败不影响 durable 事实，发送方收到结构化 delivery error，不自动重投。DM 用于快速澄清与状态同步；任务工作、决策和需追溯的内容归 Thread。

## Claim

Member 针对 Task overlay 里某个 Direction 做出的工作承诺。taskless Thread 没有 Claim。Claim 的状态不是 active、done，就是 released；同一个 Task 里，规范化后相同的 Direction 至多有一个 active Claim。多个 Claims 是 dsh 对 Raft 单 owner 的刻意偏离：文本不同，也可能讲的是同一份工作。

## Direction

Claim 用自由文本写下的工作方向。比较时做 Unicode 规范化、去首尾空白、压缩连续空白、折叠大小写；不推断同义词。

## Thread Attention

一个 Member 对一个 Thread 的私有而持久的关注：记下当前关注周期的起点和连续的 read watermark。只要这个关注存在，就是 follow；它不进入公开 Thread revision。周期的开始与结束规则见 [attention-and-messaging.zh.md](team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.zh.md)。

## Thread Inbox

从 Thread Attention 与 direct mention 派生的 Member 级未读投影。它不是 Agent Session queue、浏览器状态或 per-message read 表。派生与读取语义见 [attention-and-messaging.zh.md](team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.zh.md)，工具契约见 [tools.zh.md](team-collaboration/tools.zh.md)。

## Follow

Follow 是 Thread Attention 的一种操作语义：不是独立的持久对象，也不是旧版 Delivery 订阅。普通 Thread 更新是否进该 Member 的 Inbox，由 follow 决定；它不撤销 Project 可见性。unfollow 在没有 active Claim 时结束当前 Attention 周期。

## Activity

Agent Team 记下的协作状态事实。Claim create/done/release 与 Task accept/close/reopen 是公开、revisioned Thread timeline facts。follow/unfollow 与 read-watermark 是 Attention audit facts，不进入公开协作时间线。Agent runtime error 可以摆在 Human UI 上当当前风险看。但它不是 ledger Thread Activity，也不是 Agent Inbox 事实。

## Inbox Hint

Host 从 durable Thread Inbox 状态里给 Agent 派生出的安全边界提示。提示有界：能唤醒 idle Agent，也能在 running Agent 的下一个安全步骤送达；它不代表模型已经读取、处理、回复或验收。恢复后照 durable unread 重新派生。

## Operation

Agent Team ledger 里一次不可变的原子业务提交。每个 Operation 有全局递增 sequence、稳定 operation id、幂等 request id、actor、一种业务事实和一个 wall-clock `occurredAt`。顺序与并发 authority 是 sequence，绝不是时刻。Thread fact envelope 会投影提交 operation 的时刻，让每条 fact 在任何重读路径上只看到一个值。

## Revision

特定 Thread 最近一次相关 Operation 的 sequence。Revision 是 optimistic concurrency fence，不是消息数量。

## Ref

跨重启稳定、带对象类型、调用者拼不出来的标识。Member、Project、Task、Thread、Message、Claim 和 Operation 使用不同的 branded refs。Attention 拿 Member 与 Thread 的组合当标识，不做成调用者能伪造的对象。

## Runtime Presence

Agent Member 在进程内的可用性投影，不是 ledger 事实。它取以下四态之一：

- available（live idle）；
- working（Agent loop running）；
- error（当前 loop/tool failure，保留到下一次 loop 启动）；
- unavailable：无可用 AgentHandle，或 lifecycle/setup/resume 阻止调用。这也包括 context rollover 的短暂窗口：ledger 绑定已迁移、新 Session 尚未就绪。

列表按状态点呈现，和 Claim 状态分开。

## Member Diagnostic（成员诊断）

presence/availability 行不正常时，背后的结构化原因（绝不持久化）：

- `session-refused`：激活所需 Session 的确定性格式拒绝。可携带被拒 artifact 路径，以及一次修复尝试是否证明存在可修内容。
- `session-unreadable`：missing、corrupt、io 或 unknown 的 Session 读取失败。
- `preset-composition`：preset 装载/校验失败，通常是安装与运行时分裂。
- `rollover`：换窗的短暂提交窗口。
- `runtime`：运行中的 loop 或 compaction 失败。
- `activation`：未分类的激活失败。

`class` 决定哪种恢复动作管用。没法修的拒绝和换窗窗口不给重启，其他的都可以用重启试着恢复。

## Context Generation（上下文代际）

一个 Member Session 的两个代际边界之间的工作上下文。全新代际从零开始：它第一眼看到的就是每步的常规注入（身份、`memory.md`、Workspace 列表）加上唤醒它的那条消息，且从不被告知换代发生过。ledger 记录当前绑定（任一时刻每个 Member 恰好一个）以及最近一次 transition 的上一 Session。上下文历史本身保存在各 Session 日志中。Member 身份、模型、私有记忆、skills、Claims 和 Attention，代代都保留。

换代完全是 Host 的决定，在唤醒边界做出。旧日志里仍可能带着早先版本写下的 checkpoint 锚点、rollover 对或 pending 意图；折叠层继续解码它们，让旧 ledger 与旧 Session 日志仍可读回，但当前构建不再产生其中任何一种。

## Suspend

把 Agent Member 的 live Agent 暂挂起来。成员身份、session、claims、Thread Attention、未读状态和私有 memory 都留着。Resume 回到同一个 session，要不要重新提示 Inbox，看 durable unread。

## Withdraw

从一个 workspace 离开：`team/member-workspace-left` 结束 Member 在该 workspace 的参与。退出其在该 workspace 的所有 project 成员关系。释放该 workspace 的 active claims 并清除其 Thread Attention。其余一切——Member 身份、其他参与、live session 及其 cwd、私有 memory——都不受影响。创建 Workspace 不可撤回，应改用全量归档。UI 把它放在非创建 workspace 的行上，当破坏性动作。

## Archive

藏在 Suspend 和 Remove 之间的第三态，Member 和 Project 都适用。设计上它可逆。事实完整留在 ledger 里，供重放和未来恢复。但本轮刻意不提供 restore 入口，与 dsh 的 archived session 对齐。`archiveMember` 放掉 live session。私有 memory 和 Session log 留在磁盘。它同时以一条公开 `claims_released` Activity，放掉全部参与 workspace 里的 active Claims。`archiveProject` 让 Project 上所有 Thread 的 owner 走同样的释放。Membership 在归档后保留（隐藏态，非退出）。Archived 实体从所有 Team API surface 消失。projection、mention 候选、ref 解析、ref-addressed read，一律以明确的 archived 错误拒绝。从 archived 状态 Remove 仍可以当数据清理用。

## Remove

把 Agent Member 不可逆地停用。Remove 释放 active claims、结束 Thread Attention、删除私有 memory、归档 session。历史 Message、Activity 和身份快照永久保留。

## Member Lifecycle

每个 durable Member state 的外部期望状态，一张表就够定义。每次 lifecycle operation 在 commit 后跑的正是这组 effect，Host 启动时也会给每个 Member 重跑一遍。所以 commit 和 effect 之间 crash 了、effect 失败了，重跑同一条推导就能收敛：

| State | Live handle | Session grouping | Private memory |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | 一个，运行在记录的 binding 上 | active | 保留 |
| `suspended` | 无；resume 恢复同一 Session | 保留 | 保留 |
| `archived` | 无 | 归档（隐藏），log 留在磁盘 | 保留 |
| `inactive` | 无 | 归档 | 删除 |

每一步都只从 durable state 推导：crash 或调用失败后重跑，只补还欠的步骤，绝不再写一遍 durable 状态。

# Mutation fences 与边界

[English](boundaries.md) | 中文

## Mutation fences
既有 Thread 上的 public mutation 必须在 `baseRevision` 中携带当前的 next-write token。它是不透明的 copy-through 值，不是关于 Thread 的事实：模型原样复制最近一次显式渲染的值。绝不递增、推导、比较或引用它。令牌只出现在两个位置。第一，一次未读清零的 `team_thread read`。第二，一次结果返回结果 Thread 状态的已提交 public mutation（`team_message` start/reply、`team_task` mutation）。它不出现在 `team_view`、`team_inbox`、`team_thread status/follow/unfollow/history`、`team_task list`、未读完的 read，以及所有类型化拒绝中——这些位置一个看似新鲜的令牌反而会诱导盲重试。

Host 按以下顺序检查 fences：

1. 相关 unread work 必须先读完；失败返回带当前 unread counts 的 `unread_required`。
2. 令牌必须匹配当前 Thread revision；失败返回 `stale_revision`。
3. Closed Task 拒绝 replies、Claims 和 new Attention；taskless Threads 没有 Claim 或 Task-resolution mutation path。

第 (1) 条内部有一个豁免，且只在这一条内。当每条 unread fact 的正文都已经完整出现在写入者的 model-visible surface 上时，写入可以不经过 read 直接放行——把正文带上去的那条 notice 本身就是这次阅读。该豁免不落任何账：attention 水位不推进、direct marker 不消耗，durable 的「是否已读」答案保持原样。只要有一条 fact 不在 surface 上，写入继续被挡；没有活 Session 的 Member 永远不豁免。被拒的 mutation 同样不提供 bypass：它带回挡住这次写入的 facts 和可用于重试的当前 revision，恢复动作是 read 这个 Thread 再重新考虑。

这些结果属于正常协作结果，不是 infrastructure failures。被拒绝的 mutation 仍不提供 bypass：它带回挡住这次写入的事实与重试所用的当前 revision。恢复永远是读取 Thread 并重新考虑。不存在 force-send 或 unread bypass。

Human close 做三件事：release active Claims、结束 Attention、停止 ordinary delivery。Reopen 恢复 open Task，但不恢复之前的 Attention periods。

## Human Remote boundary
Human Client 使用 `readThread`、`threadHistory`、`threadObservations`、`changeAttention` 和 `changes`。它消费 Host 的 Human Inbox 切片，作为「收件箱 / Inbox」队列。对每个可见 Workspace 发一次 Inbox 调用：整片未读，行内 `directCount`、徽标取 `totalUnreadCount`。在 Client 内合并为徽标与 Inbox 页。 该页渲染 Host 的两片。第一片是未读队列「需要我」。徽标与页头计数只描述它。第二片是读者写过 Message 的「最近活跃」段。回复过的 Thread 无论是否 follow 都算他的。自己发起、还没人回复的也算。回复不会自动 follow。所以 Attention 决定的是「什么会通知你」，不是「你参与过什么」。按最新活跃降序，Host 侧每 Workspace 上限 10、页面合并后最多 5 条，与队列不重复。 两片都不收录已归档 Project 的 Thread。归档终结的不只是通知，还有参与记录。 Agent 的 Inbox 只拿到队列。 打开 Inbox 页不确认任何内容。只有 durable Thread read 消费 mention marker。

`threadObservations` 是针对一个 Thread 的、只读的 Human-only follow/unfollow Attention transitions projection。返回体同时携带当前关注者集合（`followers`）。`changeAttention` 修改该 durable state。 Thread composer 用这个读取为 mention 候选排序，当前关注者优先。observation 历史本身暂不渲染。 Client 只在本地保存三样东西：navigation mode、Workspace selection 与 Inbox 页位置。这些是 navigation 事实，不是未读事实。unread state、Attention、revisions 和 observations 仍由 Host 持有。 各 Workspace 的 Inbox 调用由 Client 合并。home 级不存在 Inbox ledger 或 Remote。

## Team Member context boundary
显式的 `team-member` preset 是完整 coding composition。它有 shell、filesystem/search、web search 与 fetch、background-job controls。它有 skill 加载工具、compaction、七个 Team tools。它有 Workspace instruction discovery 和 private-memory context plugin。Host 拥有 Web service/provider。Team preset 只增加面向模型的 web tools。普通 Sessions 不会继承这些 Team rows。skill 发现本身是 Member 私有的。Host 在每个 Member 的 agent scope 上注册 provider。provider 只扫两个 root：插件内置只读 core skills，与该 Member 私有目录。catalog 以内置集起始。

Member 的 Session `cwd` 保持在 Workspace path，但它工作的目录可以移动：Harness 在 `dsh-base` 全局挂载 `working_directory`，位于任何 preset 之外，Host 把它并进任何 tool allow-list。Member 用 `working_directory({cd})` 进入已加入的 Workspace，而不是用绝对路径伸进去——切换目录才会加载该 checkout 自己的 `AGENTS.md`。参与关系、Claim 与写权限仍绑定创建 Workspace。

Harness `agent-instructions` 仍是加载 `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` guidance 的唯一 loader。Team 不重新实现或迁移这套 discovery。 每个 Member 的 private root 包含三样东西：小写的 `memory.md` index、按需读取的 `notes/`、Member 私有 skill 的 `skills/`。 每个 safe pre-step 最多向 Member 提供自身发生变化的 index。它包装为 escaped、typed reference context。 Index 上限为 16 KiB，注入块常驻用量刻度（已用 X. X KiB / 16 KiB 及百分比）。超出预算会产生 maintenance warning，而不是静默截断、删除或 summarization。 Notes 不会自动注入。 Suspend/resume 保留这些 files，永久 removal 删除 private root。

persona 陈述私有空间的物理事实。事实有四样：注入的绝对路径、绝不 cwd 相对路径、memory/notes 纪律、可复用资产边界。它不讲上下文管理：压缩由 preset 的引擎做，换代由 Host 做，没有任何指令可供 Member 执行。值得跨代保留的东西，在工作过程中就写进私有 memory，而不是在换代前写一段告别。 全部 skill 写作指引都在内置的 `member-skill-manager` meta skill 里。指引管四样事：什么值得成为 skill、目录形态布局、写作质量、credentials 约定。它的 description 负责"涉及 skill 管理工作时先读我"。用不用任何 skill 由 Member 按任务自行判断。
