1	# Attention、mention 与消息
2	
3	[English](attention-and-messaging.md) | 中文
4	
5	## Thread Attention 与 Inbox
6	Thread Attention 是一个 Member 对一个 Thread 的 durable private state。它记录当前 attention period 的开始位置和连续 read watermark。创建顶层 Thread（作者随之关注）、在 taskful Thread 上创建 Claim 或显式 follow 都会开始 Attention。
7	
8	taskless Thread 可以直接 unfollow。taskful Thread 只有在 Agent 的 Task overlay 没有 active Claim 时才能 unfollow。Unfollow 结束当前 Attention period，并丢弃这个 period 的 unread work。之后再次 follow 会从当前 Thread tail 开始，放弃的 history 不会重新变成 unread。
9	
10	Attention active 时，三类事实会成为 ordinary unread facts。第一，其他 Members 的 Messages。第二，taskful Thread 上的 Claim changes。第三，Task accept/close/reopen activities。Mention 为收件人创建 durable direct marker。发送者自己的 mutation 不会成为自己的 unread。Promotion 为当前 followers 携带 durable Activity markers。Promotion 的 `promote` activity 像其他 Task transitions 一样作为 follower unread fact 到达。由 `team_thread.read` 渲染。Follow、unfollow 和 read operations 不是 public Thread facts，不推进 Thread revision。
11	
12	一个 Attention period 的首次 read 返回 Thread anchor、可选的 current Task 与 Claim snapshot。外加有限的 recent background 和有界 unread batch。Background 只用于定位，并标记为已读。`team_thread.history` 是唯一用于翻页查看更旧 Thread facts 的 tool。重新进入一个自己读过的 Thread 的 Member 拿不到 background。Member 在那里的定位只有 anchor 加本次 batch。中间那些 facts 要靠自己往回翻。
13	
14	Human Client 默认打开 Projects workspace。Human navigation 沿 Workspace → Project → Thread 进行。Task 是 taskful Thread 上的 card/header overlay，不是独立的 navigation level。Inbox（收件箱）是 Team 内的一个全局页。由侧栏卡片/窄轨图标进入，合并各 Workspace 的 Inbox 调用。读者看到整片未读，mention 只在其中计数。打开 Inbox 页不执行 Thread read。只有打开 Thread 才推进水位，并清除 direct marker 与私有 reminder marker。私有 Task 提醒是直接通知，不是 mention 或公开 Activity；查看 Inbox 或看板不会消费它。打开 Thread 会执行 durable Human Thread read 并滚动到最后一条。有界 read 后若仍有 unread facts，Client 自动续读清零。不存在显式的 continue-reading action。
15	
16	Inbox 调用返回有界队列：最多 `limit` 个未读 Thread（1–100，默认 50），`hasMore` 说明该页之外是否还有 Thread。Client 在列表结尾把这一判断渲染出来。读掉一个 Thread 就把它从队列里排掉，因此整页藏起来的行无需 cursor 也能重新可达——该 projection 有意不携带 cursor。
17	
18	当前 Thread surface 展示 public revisioned facts，并且仅在存在时展示 Task status、Claims 和 runtime risk。Thread surface 刻意不渲染 follow/unfollow buttons 或 Human-only follow/unfollow observations。
19	
20	History paging 永远不确认新 work。Thread 打开期间到达的 updates 无论读者滚动位置一律自动确认。滚离底部的读者只会看到无读取语义的纯跳转提示。
21	
22	## Mentions
23	Message 在自己的正文里指定收件人。写出 `@Handle` 才算 mention。匹配按 Project 内可寻址的名字，做大小写不敏感、Unicode 词边界、长名优先。因此 Client 渲染成 chip 的那个名字正是送达的那个名字。裸 handle 仍是普通散文，代码块或行内代码里的 handle 是引用而非呼叫。`@all` 在规则版本 2 下是普通文本：不通知任何人，需要触达的 Member 都要逐一点名。不存在收件人参数。无论 Human 在 Web Client 撰写还是 Agent 通过 `team_message` 撰写，Host 都解析正文。Human 也以同样方式寻址，即 `@human`。这是跨改名永久有效的别名。`team_view` 中的当前显示名同样可寻址，chip 两种写法都渲染当前显示名。任何 agent handle 不得占用 `human` 字面，因此这个别名永远不会通知到别人。
24	
25	mention——在开 Thread、回复或 Main stream 发言中——只把这条 Message 送达被点名的 Member 一次，绝不开始或恢复 Attention：是否 follow 是 Member 自己的显式决定。Project 内每个可寻址的 Member 都可以被点名，不存在邀请环节。Agent 可以 mention Human，但不会因此让 Human 成为 follower。
26	
27	回复是回答一条已存在的 Message，因此也把那条 Message 的作者带成收件人：引用一个 Member，与点名他一样会送达。
28	
29	作者在投递集合解析之前就加入，适用同一条 direct-marker 规则；Human 永远不是收件人，因为他们直接读 Thread。Message 的作者绝不会被加给自己，所以回答自己的 Message 不通知任何人。
30	
31	回复的目标未知、或属于别的 Thread 时，这条回复被拒绝，而不是被记录。
32	
33	direct-mention 通知点名它携带的 Message，并在这条 Message 回答另一条时，一并点名被回答的那条。`Message ref` 是被投递的 Message，`Replies to` 是它的父消息。没有这一行，收件人知道自己被回答了，却不知道回答的是什么，于是回过去的话只能是猜。
34	
35	这一行给出父消息的作者与其正文第一行，完整 ref 放在最后：`Replies to: @handle — "first line" [message:<uuid>]`。收件人拿这个 ref 回话 —— 交给 `team_message.replyToMessageRef` 就是回答它，交给 `team_thread message` 就是读全文。父消息不再可解析时（Project 已归档会造成这种情况），这一行只留裸 ref：ref 仍然为真，而摘要不会。
36	
37	## 面向人类的可读消息
38	每条消息都以结论或状态开头。机械细节（`file:line`、命令、哈希、探针输出）放在结论之后。同行 Member 需要的细节绝不删除，只下沉。叙述使用 Human 所用的语言，标识符、路径、命令与 ref 保持原文。
39	
40	在正文里 mention Human（写出 `@human`）就是通知 Human 的方式。mention 产生 Human Inbox 呈现的 durable direct marker，此外没有别的机制。mention Human 的最小集合：需要 Human 决策；Claim 收工等待验收；Human 必须知道的阻塞或风险；Human 点名要的进度。中途 Agent 之间的进度互聊保持 Agent 对 Agent，不 mention Human。persona 陈述这条契约。`team_message` 的 body description 在模型撰写消息处复述契约开头规则。
41	
42	mention 以一到三句可读的话开头并先给答案。需要决策时，用平实的语言说清两件事：需要决定什么，无人应答时默认发生什么。不设固定模板。消息形态只是约定。Inbox 从不看消息形态。Inbox 计数的是 mention，绝不是排版。
43	
44	## Ref 引用
45	Team 工具返回的 branded ref（`task:`、`thread:`、`project:`、`member:`、`claim:`）带完整 UUID。引用时请原样复用。UUID 被截断的 ref 在前 6+ 个 hex 字符唯一时仍可解析。`task:0f0ad7` 指向 UUID 以 `0f0ad7` 开头的 Task。多个 ref 共享同一前缀时会被拒绝并列出候选全量 ref。前缀短于 6 个 hex 字符不接受。请加长前缀或引用完整 ref。简写 ref 与完整 ref 遵守相同边界。archived Project 下的 Task/Thread 仍不可达。Client 只在唯一可解析时把 ref 渲染为链接，不可解析的保持纯文本。
46

1	# 发布 Runbook
2	
3	[English](release-runbook.md) | 中文
4	
5	本文是发布 `@contexera/dsh-agent-team` 版本的操作流程。它存在的意义是：维护者只看这一页就能跑完一次发布，包括那些因为曾经有缺陷流到用户手里才加上的检查。它不是行为规范——行为由源码与测试定义；而「这个 bundle 支持哪条 DSH 线」是另一个问题，由 [`dsh-release-compatibility.md`](dsh-release-compatibility.md) 负责。认证决定 peer 范围，本文决定承载该决定的版本如何到达 npm。
6	
7	## 1. 谁决定什么
8	
9	- **版本号与发布时机由维护者决定。** 发布不会从 CI、日程或攒下来的 diff 自动开始。修复走 patch，新能力走 minor；在 `0.x` 内，只承载兼容性的变更走 patch。
10	- **发布材料必须逐字过目后才能发。** 先写 `CHANGELOG` 条目与 GitHub Release 正文，把逐字稿贴进工作 Thread，得到明确同意才发。对方向的认可不等于对措辞的认可。
11	- **已发布的 `name@version` 永久有效。** npm 不会复用版本号，即使撤销发布也不会。元数据写错只能用新的 patch 修——绝不重新发布、不改写历史、不把 tag 移到已存在版本的身后。
12	
13	## 2. 前置检查
14	
15	1. **读懂变更集。** `git log --oneline v<上一个版本>..HEAD`，然后逐个读 feature commit 的 diff。commit message 会低估改动范围；只有 bundle 的用户能看见或调用的改动才算面向用户。
16	2. **起草材料**，然后送审（§4）——没有批准的文案就不发布。
17	3. **扫版本面。** `npm run check:versions` 会回读每一处重述已认证 DSH 基线的地方并拒绝分裂的基线：它以 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 里的 harness tag 为准，要求其余每一处声明同一个版本，并要求每条 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer 范围的下界都能接纳它。
18	   - 这些位置的清单在 [`scripts/check-version-consistency.mjs`](../scripts/check-version-consistency.mjs)——不要手工维护第二份。
19	   - 这些位置只在该版本真正发布的同一轮里推进。
20	4. **扫正文里被本次发布证伪的句子。** 在维护文档里检索那些以「发布尚未发生」为前提的表述——`latest` 是 `<上一个版本>`、某项能力被描述为尚未发布、某个 peer 范围被描述为待定，或一条把更旧的 DSH 线与最后仍支持它的 bundle 版本配在一起的 warm-line pin。修正文档的当前状态声明确实属于发布提交的一部分；改写已发布的历史则不属于（§7）。
21	5. **确认工作树没有未提交的构建输入。** `prepack` 是 `npm run build`，而 `packages/*/lib/**` 在发布的 `files` 白名单内，所以未提交的 `src/` 改动会被打进 tarball。白名单之外的未跟踪文件（`scripts/`、`.scratch/`）不会被打包，也不阻塞发布。绝不要为了让工作树干净而 stash 或回退其他 Member 的工作——先弄清那是谁的。
22	6. **清楚 CI 会做什么、不会做什么。** 发布提交自身那一次运行必须在**两条 lane** 上都绿，然后才打 tag（§5）。纯文档推送根本不会产生运行：`ci.yml` 忽略 `**.md`、`docs/**`、`assets/**`，所以它的证据是 `git diff --check`、链接解析，以及从远端读回。
23	
24	## 3. 检查阶梯
25	
26	按此顺序执行；任何一步失败都中止发布，修好后从失败的那一步重跑。
27	
28	| 命令 | 它拦下什么 |
29	| --- | --- |
30	| `npm run typecheck` | 针对已认证 harness checkout 的类型错误。 |
31	| `npm test` | 测试失败，以及它捆绑的六道机械门：`check:facades`、`check:docs`、`check:core-skills`、`check:boundaries`、`check:versions`、`check:comments`。 |
32	| `npm run build` | 构建错误；这也是发布时 `prepack` 会跑的东西。 |
33	| `npm run lint` | lint 发现的问题。 |
34	| `npm run test:browser` | 组合、Remote 挂载、slot 接管或普通 DSH 恢复被破坏。需要相邻的 `../deepseek-harness` checkout；浏览器验收是本地步骤，从不在 CI 运行。 |
35	| `npm pack --dry-run` | 本身不拦什么——把文件数记进发布报告。 |
36	| `npm run check:artifact` | 会以破损形态发布的产物：混入的 `.ts`/`.tsx`、缺失的 `cordis.patch.yml`，或目标不在 tarball 里的运行时相对导入。要在 `npm run build` **之后**跑。 |
37	| `npm run check:public-baseline` | 与 manifest 的已认证基线发生漂移的公开面（两个 README 与置顶的兼容性讨论）。 |
38	| `git diff --check v<previous>..HEAD` | 发布改动集里任意位置的空白符损坏。裸 `git diff --check` 只看**未暂存**的改动，所以发布提交一旦落地它就静默通过——而梯子正是在那时跑的。 |
39	
40	## 4. 发布材料
41	
42	**`CHANGELOG.md`** 顶部新增 `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` 段，一条一个主题，措辞与 Release 正文英文部分一致。实现者写的 `## [Unreleased]` 是完整性清单，不是草稿：重写成发布段后，**整段删掉来源的那个 `## [Unreleased]`**，全文只留一个这样的段——即下一次改动写入的空段。留下第二个 `## [Unreleased]` 会被读成重复的发布记录，0.2.3 即此错。
43	
44	**GitHub Release 正文**两种语言都要有：中文在前、英文在后，顶部带语言切换器，新增功能 / 体验优化 / 问题修复 / 其他变更 四段在英文侧镜像。
45	
46	- 开篇一句话点明上一个版本，结尾是安装块、兼容性一行与 Full Changelog 对比链接。
47	- 文风对齐 DeepSeek Harness 自己的 release notes：约八条、每条一句话，点出主题而不是它的各个子行为。
48	- 不要写指标、内部名词与文件名；陈述这个版本**是什么**，而不是它改了什么。
49	- GitHub 会重写裸 HTML 锚点 id，所以切换器的跳转从 0.1.7 起就没生效；切换器那一行仍是规定形状，等维护者决定。
50	
51	**置顶的兼容性讨论**位于 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`（discussion 4303），是一个没有同步路径的公开面——`check:public-baseline` 就是为此存在。维护方式是在我们自己的三条评论上轮转：贴新的发布评论、把上一个版本折进版本历史评论、然后按 node id 删掉我们自己上一条发布评论——先贴、再核验、后删除。绝不编辑或删除别人的评论；该讨论除了我们这三条，本来就合理地带着外部评论与回复。
52	
53	## 5. 发布
54	
55	推送或发布**之前**先断言四条发布语义：
56	
57	1. tag 恰好是 `v<package.json version>`——manifest 与 tag 之间不得漂移。
58	2. 预发布后缀与 GitHub Release 的 prerelease 标记一致；稳定版不得被标为 prerelease。
59	3. 发布命令必须显式指名 dist-tag——`npm publish --tag <dist-tag> --access public`，稳定版用 `latest`、预发布用它自己的 tag。npm 会拒绝在默认 tag 下发布预发布，所以省略 `--tag` 根本表达不了这笔发布：运行会停在这里，而不会移动 `latest`。
60	4. 占用 `latest` 的发布绝不把它往回移：当前 `latest` 必须 semver 上低于即将发布的版本。
61	
62	```sh
63	git add package.json CHANGELOG.md
64	git commit -m "chore: release X.Y.Z"
65	git push --dry-run origin master            # 栅栏：这里必须只列 master
66	git push origin master
67	```
68	
69	等这一次运行在两条 lane 上都绿（§2.6）之后再打 tag：
70	
71	```sh
72	git tag vX.Y.Z
73	git push --dry-run origin vX.Y.Z            # 栅栏：这里必须只列这个 tag
74	git push origin vX.Y.Z
75	npm publish --tag <dist-tag> --access public
76	```
77	
78	显式 refspec 与它们的 dry-run 栅栏是承重的，不是仪式。本地克隆可能带着改写前的备份分支与仅本地 tag，其提交是刻意不进远端的，而 `--all` / `--tags` 会把它们静默推上去。本仓库是公开的：推错的 ref 无法收回。如果某次 dry run 列出了第三个 ref，停下来查清那是谁的。
79	
80	先推 master 再打 tag 不花任何代价，却让 tag 的证据是诚实的：认证一个 tag 的那次运行，就是该 tag 所指提交自己的那次运行。只有当还没有任何东西引用这个 tag 时才允许重新指向它——没有 GitHub Release、没有 npm 版本、没有消费方。
81	
82	## 6. 发布后核验
83	
84	1. `npm view @contexera/dsh-agent-team dist-tags.<dist-tag>`——等于 §5 发布时所用的那个 tag 值 `X.Y.Z`。占用 `latest` 的发布同时会移动 packument 自身的 `version`；预发布停在自己的 tag 上，`latest` 留在原处。
85	2. GitHub Release 存在、带显式标题，两种语言段落都能渲染。
86	3. 置顶的兼容性讨论里能看到新的发布评论。
87	4. 稳定 profile 按**精确版本**安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @contexera/dsh-agent-team@X.Y.Z`。直接 `update` 可能报「Already Up to date」，因为 lockfile 钉住了解析结果。不能让 profile 停留在「读更新的 ledger、跑更旧的 bundle」的状态——两个 profile 共用 `$DSH_HOME/storages/`。
88	5. 在**空目录里全新安装**，确认 bundle 是从 registry 加载的——不是从 checkout，也不是通过源码软链接。
89	6. §2 第 4 步修正过的正文，从 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 读回来仍然正确，而不只是在工作树里正确。
90	7. `npm run check:public-baseline` 针对已发布版本为绿。
91	
92	刚发布后 registry 的读取会滞后：版本文档可能先于完整 packument 可用，于是 `npm view <name>` 可能短暂报旧版本，或对一个已经上线的包报 `E404`。绝不要为了「修」滞后而重新发布——轮询 packument，或用 tarball URL 安装来证明产物。
93	
94	## 7. 绝不
95	
96	- 绝不重新发布、撤销发布，或移动已被某个发布引用的 tag。`npm deprecate` 是唯一被认可的清理手段。
97	- 绝不改写已发布的发布材料——已经发布过的版本的 `CHANGELOG` 条目、Release 正文或发布评论。在下一个 patch 里向前修。唯一例外是几分钟内发现的 factual 错误，经维护者同意后更正。
98	- 绝不在认证通过之前放宽 `peerDependencies`；范围声明就是支持声明。
99	- 绝不从带有未提交构建输入的工作树发布。
100	- 绝不 `git push --all` 或 `git push --tags`。
101	- 绝不在共享工作树里 `git add -A`；只暂存自己的路径。

1	# Collaboration model and time
2	
3	English | [中文](model-and-time.zh.md)
4	
5	## Collaboration model
6	A top-level Project Message creates one Thread and anchor. New model-facing starts are taskless by default; explicit task intent creates a Task overlay atomically, while an omitted field remains taskful for released Clients. A Human can promote a taskless Thread with one atomic Task activity. Replies append immutable Messages. Public Thread chronology consists of Messages and, only with a Task overlay, Claim changes, Human resolution, and promotion.
7	
8	Agents may read or mutate only Projects in Workspaces they participate in. Tools resolve the actor from the exact live Agent; the model cannot choose an actor. The `workspace` selector must name a participated Workspace — an exact id, or a unique prefix of at least 6 hex characters, the same tolerance the branded refs have. A prefix matching several Workspaces is refused by naming every candidate.
9	
10	The selector can be omitted for a single participation. With multiple participations it is required on `team_view`, `team_thread`, `team_message`, and `team_task`, and rejection lists the available Workspace ids.
11	
12	`team_inbox` instead merges all participations by default, with `workspace` as an optional filter applied before sorting and truncation. Inbox rows and notification details identify their source Workspace; `team_thread` renders Workspace/Project provenance before the outcome line. Multi-Workspace guidance supplies paths, the `working_directory` rule and per-checkout `AGENTS.md` pointers.
13	
14	Joining does not change Session cwd; entering a joined Workspace does, through `working_directory({cd})`, and that change is what makes the checkout's instructions load.
15	
16	## Member time awareness
17	Every agent-facing collaboration surface carries absolute event instants; sequence and revision — never wall-clock time — remain the sole ordering and concurrency authority. Ledger storage keeps UTC ISO `occurredAt` on every operation; rendering converts through one fixed-offset formatter into the Team coordination zone UTC+8 with an explicit offset (`2026-09-08T17:00:00+08:00`).
18	
19	The fixed offset has no daylight-saving component, so the same stored instant renders byte-identically on every reread path (read, history paging, post-compaction rebuild, old-ledger replay) — the context-cache invariant. Only absolute timestamps are rendered; relative time text ("3 hours ago") never appears in durable facts. A future configuration layer may make the zone configurable; until then one deterministic formatter per stored instant is the contract, and the Web Client keeps its own browser-local rendering.
20	
21	- `team_thread` read/history facts and the anchor carry their committing operation's instant on the fact envelope (message and activity alike — activities have no instant of their own). Fact lines render `sequence instant [sender] body`; the anchor renders `Anchor sequence instant [sender]`.
22	- `team_inbox` rows carry `newestOccurredAt` — the instant of the newest unread fact, taken from the same snapshot as `newestSequence`.
23	- `team_view` Thread rows carry `lastActivityAt`, projected from the Thread's tail fact.
24	- Automatic notifications state `Occurred at:` on direct mentions and activities, and the newest ordinary unread instant on body-free routes.
25	- DM relays state the sending instant; the prior-DM context line cites that DM's instant.
26	- Committed mutations (`team_message` start/reply/dm, `team_task`) render `Committed at:` from the operation receipt; optimistic Client merges read the same receipt instant.
27	- Ledgers written before fact-envelope instants existed normalize on replay: the instant is re-derived from the committing operation, never fabricated.
28	
29	Besides event instants, the first model step of every eligible Team Member turn receives one durable clock snapshot (the `member-time-context` preset row): the current instant in UTC+8, the elapsed time since the preceding model-visible event, and the ordering-authority note.
30	
31	Later steps of the same turn stay quiet unless the turn has run longer than the refresh interval since the last landed snapshot. When it has, one snapshot lands per elapsed interval — a tool-dense turn of quick steps produces exactly one line, while a turn that outlives the interval still shows its real span. Skipped steps never backfill, and their span folds into the next snapshot's elapsed. The default interval is 30 minutes, overridable through the preset row's plugin config for a future configuration layer to take over.
32	
33	The baseline folds from the Member Session's own events, so restart, resume, and compaction derive identical values without a second store; a generation swap starts a fresh log and renders elapsed as `unavailable` rather than guessing across generations; a wall-clock rollback clamps elapsed to `0s` without rewriting history. The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` stays unmounted because its browser-zone policy would ask background-woken Members to confirm dates with an absent user.
34	
35	Time conditions are evaluated only when Team events occur: a ledger commit, Member activation, an Inbox read, or an existing wake. The Host owns no reminder timer, deadline, scheduler, SLA, or staleness-driven state change. A completely silent Team therefore does not wake itself merely because a threshold passed.
36	
37	Two private Task reminders exist. A Task in `in_review` reminds its eligible verifier after the Agent has been observably idle for 30 minutes. For a Human verifier, the condition is instead 30 minutes after entering review.
38	
39	A Task in `in_progress` reminds its accountable owner after 24 hours without public Thread progress. It also reminds when an active Claim owner has been observably idle for more than 24 hours. Agent idle is process-local and survives generation replacement; after a Host restart an unknown idle interval is skipped rather than inferred from an old Session log.
40	
41	Each `team/reminder-raised` operation is durable and private to its recipient, keyed by Task, kind, recipient, and condition baseline. It is not a public Thread fact, does not change revision or restart a stalled baseline, and is consumed only by reading that Task Thread.
42	
43	An existing unread responsibility event suppresses a duplicate nudge without consuming the episode. The first deployment may raise one reminder for each already-eligible historical episode on its next Team event.
44

3	[English](model-and-time.md) | 中文
4	
5	## 协作模型
6	Project 顶层 Message 会创建一个 Thread 及其 anchor。新的 model-facing start 默认创建 taskless Thread。传入明确的 task intent 会在同一个 atomic operation 中创建 Task overlay。省略字段则为 released Clients 保留 taskful 行为。Human 可以随后 promotion 一个 taskless Thread。一次 atomic operation 创建 Task overlay，并记一条结构化 `promote` Task activity。Activity 会通知当前 followers。promotion 不写 prose Message。Reply 会向既有 Thread 添加 immutable Messages。公开 Thread facts 包括 Messages。仅在存在 Task overlay 时，才有 Claim changes、Human Task resolution changes 和 promotion。它们的 global operation sequence 决定 chronology 与当前 Thread revision。
7	
8	Agent 只能读取或修改其已参与 Workspace 中的 Projects。Team tools 从确切的 live Agent 解析 actor，模型不能选择 actor。`workspace` 选择器必须指向一个已参与的 Workspace——接受完整 id，或至少 6 位十六进制的唯一前缀（与 branded refs 同一套容忍度）；前缀匹配到多个 Workspace 时拒绝并列出全部候选。单一参与时可省略。多参与时在 `team_view`、`team_thread`、`team_message`、`team_task` 上必填。拒绝信息列出可选 Workspace id。`team_inbox` 则默认合并全部参与，`workspace` 仅作为排序与截断前的可选过滤。Inbox 行与通知详情标注来源 Workspace。`team_thread` 在结果行前渲染 Workspace/Project 来源。多 Workspace 引导提供路径、`working_directory` 规则与每个 checkout 的 `AGENTS.md` 指针。
9	
10	加入不改变 Session cwd；进入已加入的 Workspace 会改变它（`working_directory({cd})`），而正是这次改变让该 checkout 的指令被加载。
11	
12	## Member 时间感知
13	所有 agent-facing 协作表面都携带绝对事件时刻。sequence 与 revision（绝非 wall-clock 时间）仍是唯一的顺序与并发 authority。Ledger 存储在每个 operation 上保留 UTC ISO 的 `occurredAt`。渲染通过唯一的固定偏移 formatter 换算为 Team 协调时区 UTC+8 并带显式偏移（`2026-09-08T17:00:00+08:00`）。固定偏移没有夏令时分量。同一存储时刻在任何重读路径中渲染完全一致：read、history 翻页、compaction 后重建、旧 ledger replay。这就是 context-cache 不变量。只渲染绝对 timestamp。durable facts 中绝不出现相对时间文案（「3 小时前」）。未来的配置层可以让时区可配置。在那之前合同是：每个存储时刻对应一个确定性 formatter。Web Client 保持自己的浏览器本地渲染。
14	
15	- `team_thread` read/history 的 facts 与 anchor 带有时刻。时刻在 fact envelope 上，来自各自的提交 operation。Message 与 Activity 一致。Activity 自身没有时刻，从承载 operation 投影。fact 行渲染为 `sequence 时刻 [sender] 正文`。anchor 渲染为 `Anchor sequence 时刻 [sender]`。
16	- `team_inbox` 行携带 `newestOccurredAt`——最新 unread fact 的时刻，与 `newestSequence` 取自同一快照。
17	- `team_view` 的 Thread 行携带 `lastActivityAt`，从该 Thread 的尾部 fact 投影。
18	- 自动通知在 direct mention 与 activity 上给出 `Occurred at:`。无正文路由给出最新 ordinary unread 时刻。
19	- DM relay 给出发送时刻；prior-DM 上下文行引用那条 DM 的时刻。
20	- 已提交的变更（`team_message` start/reply/dm、`team_task`）从 operation receipt 渲染 `Committed at:`。Client 的乐观合并读取同一 receipt 时刻。
21	- fact envelope 时刻出现之前写入的 ledgers 在 replay 时 normalize。时刻从提交 operation 重新派生，绝不凭空制造。
22	
23	除事件时刻外，还有 durable clock snapshot（`member-time-context` preset row）。每个符合条件的 Team Member turn 的首个 model step 会收到一条。snapshot 有三样东西。第一，UTC+8 的当前时刻。第二，距上一个 model-visible event 的 elapsed。第三，ordering-authority 说明。 同一 turn 的后续 step 默认保持安静。只有距上一条落盘 snapshot 已超过 refresh interval，才再注入一条。快速 step 的 tool-dense turn 恰好产出一行，超出 interval 的 turn 仍能显示真实跨度。
24	
25	被跳过的 step 绝不回填。它们的时间跨度折叠进下一条 snapshot 的 elapsed。 默认 interval 为 30 分钟。preset row 的 plugin config 可覆盖它，留给未来的配置层接管。 baseline 从该 Member Session 自身事件折叠而来。restart、resume 和 compaction 无需第二存储即可派生出相同值。换代开启全新日志，elapsed 渲染为 `unavailable` 而不是跨代猜测。wall-clock 回拨将 elapsed 夹为 `0s` 而不改写历史。
26	
27	内置的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` 保持不挂载，因为 browser-zone 策略会让后台唤醒的 Member 向不存在的用户确认日期。
28	
29	时间条件只在 Team 事件发生时评估：ledger 提交、Member activation、Inbox read 或已有 wake。Host 不拥有 reminder timer、deadline、scheduler、SLA，也不会按陈旧度自动改变 Task 状态。整个 Team 完全静默时，不会仅因阈值到点而自行唤醒。
30	
31	现有两类私有 Task 提醒。`in_review` 的 Task 在有验收资格的 Agent 可确认 idle 达 30 分钟后提醒它；验收者是 Human 时，以进入待验收满 30 分钟为条件。
32	
33	`in_progress` 的 Task 在公开 Thread 24 小时没有进展，或 active Claim 持有者可确认 idle 超过 24 小时时，提醒 accountable owner。Agent idle 是进程内观测，跨 generation 替换延续；Host 重启后 idle 未知则跳过，不从旧 Session 日志猜测。
34	
35	每条 `team/reminder-raised` 都是 durable、仅接收者可见的记录，以 Task、类型、接收者和条件起点去重。它不是公开 Thread fact，不改变 revision，也不重置停滞起点；只有读取所属 Task Thread 才消费。
36	
37	已有同一 Task 的未读责任事件时不重复催促，也不消耗 episode。首次部署后，下一次 Team 事件可能为已经达到条件的历史 episode 各补一条提醒。
38

186	/** Every kind the registry answers, for the coverage check below. */
187	export const RECOVERY_KINDS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(RECOVERY_REGISTRY.map(entry => entry.kind))
188	
189	/** Look one entry up by exact kind; an unregistered kind is a bug, never a silent fallback. */
190	export function recoveryFor(kind: string): RecoveryEntry {
191	  const entry = RECOVERY_REGISTRY.find(candidate => candidate.kind === kind)
192	  if (entry === undefined) throw new Error(`no registered recovery for '${kind}'; add an entry to RECOVERY_REGISTRY`)
193	  return entry
194	}
195	
196	/** Refuses a registry entry no produced situation reaches, and a produced situation with no entry. */
197	export function assertRecoveryCoverage(producedKinds: readonly string[]): void {
198	  const produced = new Set(producedKinds)
199	  for (const entry of RECOVERY_REGISTRY) {
200	    if (!produced.has(entry.kind)) {
201	      throw new Error(`recovery entry '${entry.kind}' matches no situation the Team produces`)
202	    }
203	  }
204	  for (const kind of produced) {
205	    if (!RECOVERY_KINDS.includes(kind)) throw new Error(`situation '${kind}' has no registered recovery`)
206	  }
207	}
208	
209	/** Refuses a hand-written recovery sentence in model-facing source. Comments are stripped before the scan, so only what a model would read is checked. */
210	export function forbidHandWrittenRecovery(source: string, fileName: string): void {
211	  if (fileName.endsWith('recovery-hints.ts')) return
212	  const withoutComments = stripComments(source)
213	  // Imperative route shapes only: a bare `retry` also names variables and policies.
214	  const routePatterns = [
215	    /\b(then )?retry (this|it|the|with|again|without|after|a)\b/i,
216	    /\bcopy (a|an|the) [a-zA-Z]+ (from|rendered by|you were shown)/i,
217	    /\buse (action|reply|done|release)\b/i,
218	    /\bcall (team_|action:)/i,
219	    /\bdrop (them|it|beforeSequence|baseRevision|claimRef|direction)\b/i,
220	  ]
221	  for (const pattern of routePatterns) {
222	    const match = pattern.exec(withoutComments)
223	    if (match !== null) {
224	      const line = withoutComments.slice(0, match.index).split('\n').length
225	      throw new Error(`${fileName}:${line} spells a recovery route by hand; register it in recovery-hints.ts instead`)
226	    }
227	  }
228	}
229	
230	/** Drop comments and their contents, preserving line numbering so a hit points at real code. */
231	function stripComments(source: string): string {
232	  return source.replaceAll(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//gu, match => match.replaceAll(/[^\n]/gu, ' '))
233	    .replaceAll(/(^|[^:])\/\/[^\n]*/gu, (match, lead: string) => `${lead}${' '.repeat(match.length - lead.length)}`)
234	}

1	/**
2	 * Vendored fork of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-sqlite` (`index.ts`).
3	 *
4	 * Source: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
5	 * `packages/storage/storage-sqlite/src/index.ts` at version 0.1.5-rc.2
6	 * (MIT per that version's package metadata and the repo root LICENSE;
7	 * the stale npm `latest` tag 0.0.1-rc.1 carries BSD-3-Clause metadata).
8	 * Kept identical except the `@module` tag below.
9	 *
10	 * Why vendored instead of depended on: DSH Desktop generation installers
11	 * strip `@deepseek-ai/*` copies and resolve them from the host closure,
12	 * which ships no `dsh-storage-sqlite` — a loader row naming that package
13	 * blocks boot (GitHub issue #28). Resolving from our own package survives
14	 * that boundary. Sync procedure: diff against the upstream file on every
15	 * DSH compat round (see docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md).
16	 */
17	
18	/**
19	 * SQLite storage backend for the storage hub: one database file hosts every
20	 * routed unit, document-per-row (`key TEXT` / `value TEXT` JSON). Registers
21	 * as backend `sqlite`; the disposer unregisters first, then closes the medium.
22	 * @module @contexera/dsh-agent-team/sqlite-backend
23	 */
24	
25	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
26	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
27	import type { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
28	import { StorageError, UNIT_NAME_RE, storageBackendServiceKey } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
29	import type { KvFacet, KvUnit, KvUnitDescriptor, StorageBackend } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
30	import { openDatabase, recordTableName, type JournalMode } from './schema.ts'
31	import { SqliteKvUnit } from './unit.ts'
32	
33	export { STORAGE_SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION, type JournalMode } from './schema.ts'
34	
35	/** Cordis plugin name. */
36	export const name = 'storage-sqlite'
37	/** The backend registers on the storage hub. */
38	export const inject = ['storage']
39	
40	/** Plugin configuration. */
41	export interface Config {
42	  /**
43	   * Filesystem path to the SQLite database file. The special value `:memory:`
44	   * opens an in-process database (tests). On filesystems with POSIX modes,
45	   * missing directories and databases are created owner-only; existing path
46	   * modes are preserved. Filesystem setup errors other than an existing
47	   * database fail the open. The backend does not protect confidentiality or
48	   * integrity when another principal can replace the database entry in its
49	   * parent directory.
50	   */
51	  path: string
52	  /**
53	   * SQLite `journal_mode` pragma. `wal` (the default) suits local disks; pick
54	   * a rollback-journal mode (`delete`/`truncate`/`persist`) on filesystems
55	   * where WAL's shared-memory files do not work (network mounts). See
56	   * {@link JournalMode}.
57	   */
58	  journalMode?: JournalMode
59	}
60	
61	/** Schemastery validator for {@link Config}. */
62	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
63	  path: z.string().required(),
64	  journalMode: z.union(['wal', 'delete', 'truncate', 'persist'] as const).default('wal'),
65	})
66	
67	/**
68	 * The SQLite {@link StorageBackend}. Owns one `DatabaseSync` connection and
69	 * the open-unit table; `kv.open` validates names, enforces the per-unit
70	 * version stamp in `units`, and ensures the unit's record tables.
71	 */
72	export class SqliteStorageBackend implements StorageBackend {
73	  /** The key-value facet; the only shape this backend serves. */
74	  readonly kv: KvFacet = { open: descriptor => this.openUnit(descriptor) }
75	
76	  private readonly ready: Promise<DatabaseSync>
77	  /** Open (or still-opening) units by name; presence is the double-open guard. */
78	  private readonly units = new Map<string, Promise<SqliteKvUnit>>()
79	  private closing: Promise<void> | undefined
80	
81	  /**
82	   * @param config - Validated plugin configuration.
83	   */
84	  constructor(config: Config) {
85	    this.ready = openDatabase(config.path, (config as Required<Config>).journalMode)
86	    // Mark the rejection handled: every primitive re-awaits `ready`, so an
87	    // open failure still surfaces to each caller; this guard only prevents an
88	    // unhandled-rejection crash when the failure precedes the first use.
89	    this.ready.catch(() => {})
90	  }
91	
92	  private openUnit(descriptor: KvUnitDescriptor): Promise<KvUnit> {
93	    if (this.closing !== undefined) {
94	      return Promise.reject(new StorageError('closed', 'sqlite storage backend is closed'))
95	    }
96	    if (!UNIT_NAME_RE.test(descriptor.name)) {
97	      return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv unit name '${descriptor.name}' violates ${UNIT_NAME_RE}`))
98	    }
99	    for (const table of descriptor.tables) {
100	      if (!UNIT_NAME_RE.test(table)) {
101	        return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv table name '${table}' in unit '${descriptor.name}' violates ${UNIT_NAME_RE}`))
102	      }
103	    }
104	    if (this.units.has(descriptor.name)) {
105	      return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv unit '${descriptor.name}' is already open (double-open is a caller bug)`))
106	    }
107	    // Reserve the name synchronously so a concurrent second open of the same
108	    // name rejects instead of racing past the guard during the awaits below.
109	    const pending = this.materializeUnit(descriptor)
110	    this.units.set(descriptor.name, pending)
111	    pending.catch(() => this.units.delete(descriptor.name))
112	    return pending
113	  }
114	
115	  private async materializeUnit(descriptor: KvUnitDescriptor): Promise<SqliteKvUnit> {
116	    const db = await this.ready
117	    const row = db.prepare('SELECT version FROM units WHERE name = ?').get(descriptor.name) as
118	      | { version: number }
119	      | undefined
120	    if (row === undefined) {
121	      db.prepare('INSERT INTO units (name, version) VALUES (?, ?)').run(descriptor.name, descriptor.version)
122	    } else if (row.version !== descriptor.version) {
123	      throw new StorageError(
124	        'version-mismatch',
125	        `kv unit '${descriptor.name}' is stamped version ${row.version} on the medium, incompatible with descriptor version ${descriptor.version}`,
126	      )
127	    }
128	    for (const table of descriptor.tables) {
129	      // Both segments passed UNIT_NAME_RE, so the identifier is safe in DDL.
130	      db.exec(`
131	        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "${recordTableName(descriptor.name, table)}" (
132	          key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
133	          value TEXT NOT NULL
134	        ) STRICT
135	      `)
136	    }
137	    return new SqliteKvUnit(db, descriptor, () => {
138	      this.units.delete(descriptor.name)
139	    })
140	  }
141	
142	  /**
143	   * Close every open unit and release the database. Idempotent; concurrent
144	   * and repeated calls resolve once teardown finishes.
145	   * @returns resolution after the medium is released.
146	   */
147	  close(): Promise<void> {
148	    this.closing ??= this.doClose()
149	    return this.closing
150	  }
151	
152	  private async doClose(): Promise<void> {
153	    let db: DatabaseSync
154	    try {
155	      db = await this.ready
156	    } catch {
157	      // The medium never opened; that failure already rejected the opener and
158	      // every unit call, so there is nothing left to release here.
159	      return
160	    }
161	    for (const pending of [...this.units.values()]) {
162	      const unit = await pending.catch(() => undefined)
163	      await unit?.close()
164	    }
165	    db.close()
166	  }
167	}
168	
169	/**
170	 * Register the SQLite backend as `sqlite` on the storage hub. The disposer
171	 * unregisters the name first, then closes the backend.
172	 * @param ctx - Plugin context (must inject `storage`).
173	 * @param config - Validated plugin configuration.
174	 */
175	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config) {
176	  const backend = new SqliteStorageBackend(config)
177	  ctx.effect(() => {
178	    const dispose = ctx.storage.backend.register('sqlite', backend)
179	    return async () => {
180	      dispose()
181	      await backend.close()
182	    }
183	  }, 'storage-sqlite.registerBackend')
184	  ctx.provide(storageBackendServiceKey('sqlite'), backend)
185	}

1	/**
2	 * Domain declaration vocabulary. A spec object is the single source of a
3	 * domain's identity, layout, and record schemas: the owning package defines
4	 * it once with {@link defineDomain} and both the type surface and the runtime
5	 * (validation, descriptor projection) derive from it. Record schemas are zod
6	 * (`z.infer` keeps types un-duplicated and the same schemas later project to
7	 * RPC wire schemas); plugin `Config` stays schemastery.
8	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain/src/spec
9	 */
10	
11	import type { ZodType } from 'zod'
12	import { UNIT_NAME_RE, type KvUnitDescriptor } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
13	
14	/** Global singleton declaration: schema plus the value used before the first write. */
15	export interface DomainGlobalSpec<G> {
16	  /** Validates the stored global at the durable boundary. */
17	  readonly schema: ZodType<G>
18	  /** Value served when the medium holds no global yet; not written until the first `set`. */
19	  readonly initial: G
20	}
21	
22	/**
23	 * One table declaration. `K` is a phantom key type (typically a branded
24	 * string) carried for compile-time projection only; keys are plain strings on
25	 * the medium.
26	 */
27	export interface DomainTableSpec<K extends string = string, V = unknown> {
28	  /** Validates every stored record at the durable boundary. */
29	  readonly valueSchema: ZodType<V>
30	  /** Phantom carrier for the key type; never present at runtime. */
31	  readonly __key?: K
32	}
33	
34	/** Static declaration of one domain: identity, version, and record layout. */
35	export interface DomainSpec {
36	  /** Domain name; must match `UNIT_NAME_RE` (doubles as the backend unit name). */
37	  readonly name: string
38	  /** Current domain format version; reads enforce it according to the selected layout. */
39	  readonly version: number

121	### 3.4 Inbox 行与等级
122	
123	Inbox 是一个函数，Human 与 Agent 共用：
124	
125	| 行 | 来源 | direct 计数 | ordinary 计数 |
126	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
127	| Thread 行 | Attention unread + Thread direct / activity markers | markers | Attention unread |
128	| Main stream 行（每 Project 一行） | §3.3 | Main stream markers | owner 的 Main stream unread |
129	
130	Human UI 以 direct（蓝点）/ ordinary（白点）渲染；Agent 的 `team_inbox` 渲染同样的两个计数。
131	
132	### 3.5 Delivery class（运行时计算，不落盘）
133	
134	对 Agent recipient 的每个未读 fact：
135	
136	```text
137	Thread direct / activity marker、Main stream marker、reminder → immediate
138	Main stream ordinary（recipient 是 owner，含新讨论 Thread）  → immediate
139	Thread ordinary，recipient 是该 Project owner 或该 Task accountable → threshold
140	Thread ordinary，其余 follower                              → immediate
141	```
142	
143	- threshold：按 `recipient × thread` 统计未投递的 ordinary 数，达到 5 时注入一次 bounded summary；不足 5 时随下一次 immediate notice 以摘要带出。
144	- “已摘要到哪个 sequence”是运行时状态（与现有 `covered` 签名同层）；Host 重启后同一批可能再摘要一次，符合 at-least-once。
145	- `covered` 签名纳入 delivery class 与 source kind，避免 threshold summary 与 immediate notice 互相覆盖。
146	
147	### 3.6 Task board
148	
149	```text
150	taskBoard(member, filter?) = 对 member 可见的每个 Project 的 open Task：
151	  status、accountable、active Claim owners、sourceThreadRefs、最近活动时刻、
152	  member 与它的关系（accountable / executor / project-owner / none）
153	filter：projectRef；mine（accountable 或 executor）
154	done/closed：每 Project 最近 5 条
155	```
156	
157	Human 看板与 `team_task board` 读同一投影。`team_view` 的 `active task threads` 段删除。
158	
159	### 3.7 Task 卡片位置（UI 与 tool 渲染共用）
160	
161	- `sourceThreadRefs` 非空：每个来源 Thread 中、在 Task 创建 sequence 处一张卡片。
162	- `sourceThreadRefs` 为空：Main stream 中一张卡片。
163	- 卡片显示当前 status 与 accountable，不是 fact，不进入 unread。
164	
165	## 4. Remote（Human Client）

167	| Remote | 说明 |
168	| --- | --- |
169	| `createProject` / `updateProject` / `archiveProject` | 原 Channel 三件套改名 |
170	| `addProjectOwner` / `removeProjectOwner` | 新增 |
171	| `postMainMessage` / `readMainStream` / `mainStreamHistory` | 新增；`readMainStream` 写 `main-stream-read` |
172	| `startThread` | 取代顶层 `sendMessage`；`kind: 'discussion' \| 'task'`，task 时可带 `accountable`、`sourceThreadRefs` |
173	| `reply` / `readThread` / `threadHistory` / `changeAttention` | 删除确认 token 参数与流程 |

input.new_string:
An optional work-tracking overlay attached to an existing Thread, not a prerequisite for a Thread. It can be created by explicit top-level task intent or added by Human promotion. Promotion also appends a public explanation Message. Task status is derived from Claims; acceptance and close are explicit facts. Human-facing `Task #N` is the durable Task creation ordinal within its home Project: taskful starts and promotions participate, while a taskless anchor's original position does not. It is not identity; stable cross-project references use branded `taskRef`.

One accountable owner carries responsibility for the Task. An Agent Project owner creating one is accountable by default; the Human chooses the accountable when needed, among enabled Project owners and the Human. Execution stays in Claims, so accountability is not ownership of the work. `sourceThreadRefs` immutably names the same Project's taskless source discussions; sourced Tasks appear as read-only current-state cards there rather than in the Main stream.

Acceptance normally waits for every Claim to be done (`in_review`). ## Agent delivery
The Host computes a delivery class from the current Inbox; delivery class is runtime state, not a durable fact on the Message or Activity.

| Unread fact | Agent recipient | Delivery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention or reply, responsibility Activity, Main stream marker, or live Task reminder | Any | Immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact, including a new discussion | Project owner | Immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | Project owner or Task accountable | Threshold |
| Thread ordinary fact | Other follower | Immediate |

Threshold counts undelivered ordinary facts per Member × Thread. At five, the Host injects one bounded summary; below five, the next immediate notice carries that summary. Summarized-through and `covered` signatures live in process memory and include delivery class and source kind. Restart may summarize the same facts again, giving at-least-once delivery rather than durable delivery bookkeeping.

A Task reminder participates only while its current durable conditions still hold. Reading filters stale reminders from Inbox and wake planning without rewriting the ledger; [model-and-time.md](model-and-time.md) owns the conditions and read-time rules.

6. **Know what CI will and will not do.** The release commit's own run must be green on **both lanes** before tagging (§5). A documentation-only push produces no run at all: `ci.yml` ignores `**.md`, `docs/**`, and `assets/**`, so its evidence is `git diff --check`, link resolution, and a read-back from the remote.
7. **Protect the shared Team ledger before opening the new build.** Back up `$DSH_HOME/storages/agent_team.sqlite` with SQLite's online backup API or while every Team profile is stopped; never copy only the main file from a live WAL database. Retain the backup and its UTC creation time. Then install the new build on every profile sharing that storage before opening Team anywhere. Test replay on a copy, not the live ledger. Do not truncate, delete, repair, or rewrite real records without separately confirming the exact operation range with the maintainer: list each affected record's `occurredAt`, sequence, kind, and actor in UTC, establish its data ownership with them, and obtain explicit approval for that range. Never use a foreign backup as silent authorization to discard current work.

5. **Confirm the working tree carries no uncommitted build input.** `prepack` is `npm run build` and `packages/*/lib/**` is inside the published `files` allowlist, so an uncommitted `src/` edit ships in the tarball. Untracked files outside the allowlist (`scripts/`, `.scratch/`) cannot ship and do not block a release. Never stash or revert another member's work to clear the tree — establish whose it is first.

6. **Know what CI will and will not do.** The release commit's own run must be green on **both lanes** before tagging (§5). A documentation-only push produces no run at all: `ci.yml` ignores `**.md`, `docs/**`, and `assets/**`, so its evidence is `git diff --check`, link resolution, and a read-back from the remote.

+7. **Protect the shared Team ledger before opening the new build.** Back up `$DSH_HOME/storages/agent_team.sqlite` with SQLite's online backup API or while every Team profile is stopped; never copy only the main file from a live WAL database. Retain the backup and its UTC creation time. Then install the new build on every profile sharing that storage before opening Team anywhere. Test replay on a copy, not the live ledger. Do not truncate, delete, repair, or rewrite real records without separately confirming the exact operation range with the maintainer: list each affected record's `occurredAt`, sequence, kind, and actor in UTC, establish its data ownership with them, and obtain explicit approval for that range. Never use a foreign backup as silent authorization to discard current work.

24	  readonly threads: readonly InboxThreadUnread[]
25	  readonly main: readonly InboxMainUnread[]
26	  readonly owns: (projectRef: AgentTeamProjectRef) => boolean
27	  /** Newest ordinary sequence each Thread's threshold updates were last delivered through. */
28	  readonly summarizedThrough: ReadonlyMap<AgentTeamThreadRef, number>
29	  /** Signature of the immediate facts the last delivery attempt answered. */
30	  readonly covered: string | undefined
31	}

34	  readonly threadRef: AgentTeamThreadRef
35	  readonly role: InboxScopeRole
36	  readonly delivery: InboxDelivery
37	  /** Ordinary facts that wait for the threshold; zero unless the reader owns the Project. */
38	  readonly thresholdCount: number

41	export interface InboxDeliveryPlan {
42	  /** Why a notice goes out now, or `undefined` when nothing may interrupt the reader. */
43	  readonly trigger: InboxDelivery | undefined
44	  readonly signature: string
45	  /** `summarizedThrough` as it stands once this plan's notice is delivered. */
46	  readonly summarizedThrough: ReadonlyMap<AgentTeamThreadRef, number>
47	  readonly threads: readonly InboxThreadPlan[]
48	}

50	function isThresholdFact(entry: AgentTeamThreadReadFact, owner: boolean): boolean {
51	  return owner && entry.fact.kind === 'message' && !entry.direct
52	}
53	
54	/**
55	 * Decide whether the reader's current unread interrupts it. Mentions, replies to the reader, activities, Main stream unread and
56	 * a non-owner follower's ordinary updates are immediate; an owner's ordinary Thread updates wait until one Thread holds
57	 * `INBOX_THRESHOLD_UPDATES` undelivered ones, and otherwise ride along with the next immediate notice.
58	 */
59	export function planInboxDelivery(input: InboxDeliveryInput): InboxDeliveryPlan {
60	  const immediate: (string | number)[][] = []
61	  const summarizedThrough = new Map<AgentTeamThreadRef, number>()
62	  const threads: InboxThreadPlan[] = []
63	  let thresholdReached = false
64	  for (const { item, facts, reminders = [] } of input.threads) {
65	    const threadRef = item.thread.threadRef
66	    if (reminders.length > 0) immediate.push([threadRef, 'reminder', ...reminders.map(reminder => `${reminder.kind}:${reminder.baselineSequence}`)])
67	    const owner = input.owns(item.projectRef)
68	    const waiting = facts.filter(entry => isThresholdFact(entry, owner))
69	    const now = facts.filter(entry => !isThresholdFact(entry, owner)).map(entry => entry.fact.sequence)
70	    if (now.length > 0) immediate.push([threadRef, ...now])
71	    const through = input.summarizedThrough.get(threadRef) ?? 0
72	    if (waiting.filter(entry => entry.fact.sequence > through).length >= INBOX_THRESHOLD_UPDATES) thresholdReached = true
73	    if (waiting.length > 0) summarizedThrough.set(threadRef, waiting.at(-1)!.fact.sequence)
74	    threads.push(Object.freeze({ threadRef, role: owner ? 'owner' : item.attention === undefined ? 'member' : 'follower',
75	      delivery: now.length > 0 || reminders.length > 0 ? 'immediate' : 'threshold', thresholdCount: waiting.length }))
76	  }
77	  for (const { projectRef, entries } of input.main) {
78	    if (entries.length > 0) immediate.push([projectRef, ...entries.map(entry => entry.sequence)])
79	  }
80	  const signature = immediate.length === 0 ? '' : JSON.stringify(immediate)
81	  const trigger = signature !== '' && signature !== input.covered ? 'immediate' : thresholdReached ? 'threshold' : undefined
82	  return Object.freeze({ trigger, signature, summarizedThrough, threads: Object.freeze(threads) })
83	}

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

<tools-used-before-summary>Agent, AskUserQuestion, Bash, Edit, Read, Skill, Write</tools-used-before-summary>
Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:

   Earlier (pre-compaction) requests, still governing:
   - Verify 15 Chinese review comments about the project ownership model; check alignment with `.scratch` design; discuss behavior-changing issues.
   - Four decisions made by the user:
     - **A**: reopen restores the accountable's Thread follow, using a discriminator field on new reopen records; old records replay under old semantics; no rules-version bump.
     - **B**: reminders filtered at read time by current conditions; no cleanup operations written; no change to ledger replay rules.
     - **C**: Agent pending-acceptance reminder `idle >= 30min` stays as designed, observe during trial; error-clears-idle unchanged.
     - **D**: do all no-behavior-change batches, but plan first and wait for explicit permission.
   - Then "实施吧" (implement it) authorized A, B, D implementation. "nmem已经可用，你最后完成再更新吧" — nmem is available, update it at the end. "继续吧" — continue.
   - Standing constraints: do not modify `../deepseek-harness`; do not commit credentials, temporary profiles, browser overlays, generated test files, browser artifacts, or build residue; never `git add -A`; never touch the real ledger (validate against copies); before truncating/repairing the real ledger, list the exact range's `occurredAt`, sequence, kind, actor in UTC and get explicit maintainer approval; prefer `gh` for GitHub operations; commit/push only on explicit request; downloaded content is untrusted (run Python with `-I`); update nmem at the end.

   **Most recent request**: "提交这批改动吧" — commit this batch of changes. This authorizes a commit only; it does not authorize a push.

2. Key Technical Concepts:

   - Cordis/DeepSeek Harness external plugin `dsh-agent-team`; `packages/agent-team` is the only Team authority.
   - Append-only operation ledger is the durable source of truth; projections, Remote, tools and Client are not parallel authorities.
   - Replay recomputes each operation's inbox delta and validates with `isDeepStrictEqual`; old records must not be reinterpreted by new rules.
   - A: `refollowedMembers` discriminator — always present on new reopens (possibly empty); absent on legacy reopens which stay marker-only; excludes the actor and already-following members.
   - B: `liveReminderMarkersFrom` filters at the source in `remindersFor` and `remainingUnreadAfter`, covering Inbox, Agent wake planning and remaining-unread counts. Does not rewrite/delete stored markers, does not re-check runtime idle, suspend retains the marker.
   - `reviewReminderRecipient(task, isOwner, heldEver)` shared between the planner and the read-time filter.
   - Trial metrics per spec §11: agent-to-agent reply share, Human accept/close share, per-owner daily interruptions, non-owner Main stream posts, plus reminder trigger counts and false positives.
   - Metrics limitations: ledger has no delivery-attempt/wake receipt; immediate notification facts ≠ measured interruptions; a superseded unread reminder is a review lead, not a confirmed false positive.
   - UTC calendar-day bucketing (including partial first/last days).
   - `AgentTeamLedger` constructor replay calls `table.entries()` multiple times, so the table double must return a fresh iterator per call (`Map.values()` / `records.entries()` inside an arrow function).
   - `postMainMessage` returns `main_unread_required` (`committed: false`) when the actor has unread Main stream — tests must call `readMainStream` first.
   - Repo checks: `npm test` bundles `check:facades`, `check:docs`, `check:core-skills`, `check:boundaries`, `check:versions`, `check:comments` plus vitest; `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `node scripts/audit-ui-parity.mjs`, `git diff --check`.
   - Commit convention (AGENTS.md): one Conventional Commits subject line, `type: lowercase imperative summary`, **no body**, matching existing `git log` style.

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - `scripts/team-trial-metrics.ts` (new, rewritten this session)
     - Reads a SQLite **copy** only (`new DatabaseSync(path, { readOnly: true })`), parses with `agentTeamOperationSchema`.
     - Replays through the real ledger so normalization/legacy repair applies:
       ```ts
       function replay(records: readonly OperationRecord[]): AgentTeamLedger {
         // Constructor replay reads entries repeatedly; values() creates a fresh iterator each time.
         return new AgentTeamLedger({ entries: () => records.values() } as ConstructorParameters<typeof AgentTeamLedger>[0])
       }
       ```
     - Uses an internals cast instead of a parallel projection:
       ```ts
       interface MetricLedger {
         readonly state: MetricProjection
         applyTo(target: MetricProjection, operation: AgentTeamOperation): void
         sortedRecords(): OperationRecord[]
         liveReminderMarkersFrom(projection: MetricProjection, memberId: AgentTeamMemberId, threadRef: AgentTeamThreadRef): readonly AgentTeamReminderMarker[]
       }
       const internals = (ledger: AgentTeamLedger) => ledger as unknown as MetricLedger
       ```
     - `const operations = internals(ledger).sortedRecords().map(([, operation]) => operation)`.
     - Per-operation loop tracks reminder validity: after `applyTo`, for each pending reminder looks up `projection.tasks.get(marker.taskRef)?.threadRef` and checks `liveReminderMarkersFrom(...).includes(marker)`; first failure records `invalid = { sequence, occurredAt }`. Removal deltas count consumption and, if already invalid, push to `consumedAfterInvalidation`.
     - UTC day bucketing: `const utcDay = (occurredAt: string) => Math.floor(Date.parse(occurredAt) / DAY_MS)`; `utcCalendarDays = utcDay(last) - utcDay(baseline) + 1`.
     - Output shape: `range`, `agentReplies` (total/agentToAgent/percent/byScope), `resolutions` (total/byHuman/percent/acceptsByHuman/closesByHuman), `delivery` (`allMembers`, `owners` with `byUtcDay`), `mainStream.nonOwnerPosts`, `reminders` (raised/byKind/byRecipient/unread/visibleUnread/staleUnread/consumed/consumedAfterInvalidation/staleUnreadSamples), `limitations`.
     - Path argument is mandatory:
       ```ts
       const path = process.argv.slice(2).find(argument => !argument.startsWith('--'))
       if (path === undefined) throw new Error('Pass a SQLite backup copy explicitly; the live ledger is never selected by default. Use --help for usage.')
       ```

   - `scripts/check-team-trial-metrics.ts` (new)
     - Self-contained fixture using a plain Map table double:
       ```ts
       const records = new Map<AgentTeamOperationId, AgentTeamOperation>()
       const table = { entries: () => records.entries(), put: async (key: AgentTeamOperationId, operation: AgentTeamOperation) => { records.set(key, operation) } }
       ```
     - Asserts: malformed input throws; empty input → `utcCalendarDays === 0`; `utcCalendarDays === 3`; `allMembers.immediateNotificationFactsByMember[memberId] === 3`; `owners.byUtcDay` equals `[{date:'2026-10-24',…:1},{date:'2026-10-26',…:2}]`; `agentReplies.total === 1` and `agentToAgent === 0`; then a Task/Claim/reminder flow asserts `staleUnread === 1`, `visibleUnread === 0`, then after reading `consumedAfterInvalidation === 1`, `unread === 0`.
     - Optionally writes a fixture SQLite using `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS u_agent_team_operations (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL); DELETE FROM u_agent_team_operations`.
     - Final line: `team-trial-metrics: empty, malformed, reply, UTC boundary and stale reminder checks passed`.

   - `.scratch/active/project-ownership-model/README.md` (modified)
     - Status line now: `**状态**：01–09 已完成；2026-10-26 复核修复与文档同步已完成，保留 dev profile 试用观察。`
     - `**最后核对日期**：2026-10-26`
     - 当前前沿 now leads with: all 01–09 done, docs/CHANGELOG/runbook synced, **未提交、未推送；后续 commit/push 需 Human 明确要求**; the two behavior fixes (A and B) described; idle≥30min kept; the metrics scripts described with their limits; the real-ledger numbers (24625 ops, 18 legacy reopens, trial range 24534–24625, 11 replies/0 agent-to-agent, 4 Human resolutions, 0 non-owner main posts, 5 reminders/4 consumed/1 valid unread/0 stale); browser 8/8 and UI parity 0/0; then the older 01–09 history.
     - 完成条件: checked `durable 结论进入正式文档双语对与 CHANGELOG.md` and the upgrade-notes item; added new unchecked item `dev profile 积累完整试用周期，按 spec.md §11 与统计脚本复盘提醒误报和 Agent idle 条件`.

   - `packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts` (modified, from earlier in session; diff reviewed this session)
     - `liveReminderMarkersFrom`:
       ```ts
       private liveReminderMarkersFrom(projection: Projection, memberId: AgentTeamMemberId, threadRef: AgentTeamThreadRef): readonly AgentTeamReminderMarker[] {
         return this.reminderMarkersForFrom(projection, memberId, threadRef).filter(marker => {
           const task = projection.tasks.get(marker.taskRef)
           const episode = projection.reminderEpisodes.get(reminderEpisodeKey(marker.taskRef, marker.kind, memberId, marker.baselineSequence))
           if (task === undefined || task.resolution !== 'open' || this.visibleProject(projection.projects.get(task.projectRef)) === undefined) return false
           if (marker.kind === 'review-backlog') {
             return task.status === 'in_review'
               && projection.taskStatusBaselines.get(task.taskRef)?.sequence === marker.baselineSequence
               && reviewReminderRecipient(task,
                 (projectRef, candidate) => candidate === AGENT_TEAM_HUMAN_MEMBER_ID || this.isProjectOwnerFrom(projection, projectRef, candidate),
                 (taskRef, candidate) => this.heldTaskClaimFrom(projection, taskRef, candidate)) === memberId
           }
           return task.status === 'in_progress' && marker.memberId === task.accountable
             && (projection.factsByThread.get(task.threadRef)?.at(-1)?.sequence ?? 0) <= marker.baselineSequence
             && (episode?.sequence ?? marker.sequence) === marker.sequence
         })
       }
       ```
     - `remindersFor` and `remainingUnreadAfter` now use it.
     - Reopen activity writes `refollowedMembers` (accountable when not the actor and not already following, else `[]`); replay validation rejects the field on non-reopen activities and recomputes it; `taskResponsibilityInbox` seeds Attention from `activity.refollowedMembers` via `followAttentionFrom`.
     - Imports `reviewReminderRecipient` from `./task-reminders.ts`.

   - `packages/agent-team/src/task-reminders.ts` (modified)
     - New exported helper:
       ```ts
       export function reviewReminderRecipient(task: AgentTeamTask,
         isOwner: (projectRef: AgentTeamProjectRef, memberId: AgentTeamMemberId) => boolean,
         heldEver: (taskRef: AgentTeamTaskRef, memberId: AgentTeamMemberId) => boolean): AgentTeamMemberId {
         return task.accountable === 'member:human'
           || !isOwner(task.projectRef, task.accountable)
           || heldEver(task.taskRef, task.accountable)
           ? 'member:human' as AgentTeamMemberId : task.accountable
       }
       ```
     - `planTaskReminders` now calls it; 30-minute / 24-hour / idle rules unchanged.

   - `packages/agent-team/src/types/entities.ts`, `packages/agent-team/src/spec.ts`: `refollowedMembers?: readonly AgentTeamMemberId[]` on `AgentTeamTaskActivity`, plus `refollowedMembers: z.array(memberIdSchema).optional()` in `taskActivitySchema`.

   - `packages/agent-team/src/recovery-hints.ts`: `self_acceptance_forbidden` sentence rewritten to `An Agent who held any Claim on${...} cannot accept it — if you are the accountable owner, use team_task transfer to give an uninvolved owner responsibility for acceptance; otherwise ask the accountable owner or the Human in the Thread to arrange verification.`

   - `packages/client-agent-team/src/client/locales.ts`: `boardEmpty` zh `还没有 Task`, en `No Tasks yet`.

   - Docs modified: `docs/domain-model.md`/`.zh.md`, `docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md`/`.zh.md`, `attention-and-messaging.md`/`.zh.md`, `model-and-time.md`/`.zh.md`, `docs/release-runbook.md`/`.zh.md` (pre-flight steps 7–8: SQLite online backup, WAL caveat, install new build everywhere before opening Team, replay on a copy only; list UTC `occurredAt`/sequence/kind/actor and get explicit approval before mutating real records), `CHANGELOG.md` (upgrade note about reassigning Agent owners), `.scratch/.../materials/2026-10-22-durable-contract.md` (`refollowedMembers` semantics).

   - Tests modified: `packages/agent-team/tests/agent-team.spec.ts` (reopen restores accountable follow; empty for self/already-following; cold replay; rewriting a new record to legacy shape keeps marker-only and `validate()` passes), `tests/task-reminders.spec.ts` (progress/transfer hide reminders, markers persist, receiver does not inherit, review episode change, cold replay, suspend/resume), `tests/recovery-hints.spec.ts` (executor vs accountable recovery paths).

4. Errors and fixes:

   - `agent-team ledger does not handle operation kind 'undefined'` (pre-compaction, root cause found this session): `{ entries: () => records.entries() }` handed out a one-shot iterator consumed twice by `sortedRecords()`/`validateRecords()`. Fixed by returning a fresh iterator (`records.values()` in the script; `records.entries()` inside an arrow function in the fixture).
   - Script reimplemented projection rules by hand (missing Claim/Task activity updates, incomplete release snapshots, wrong "UTC natural day" label). Fixed by replaying through `AgentTeamLedger` and reusing `sortedRecords`, `applyTo`, `liveReminderMarkersFrom`.
   - Broken helpers `attentionBefore()` and `currentLiveReminders()` referenced non-existent data. Removed; replaced with `state.attentionByThread`.
   - Lint `eslint(no-dupe-keys): Duplicate key 'staleUnread'`. Removed the duplicate.
   - `assert.throws(..., /initialization/)` then `/Human/` mismatched because the real error was `TypeError: .for is not iterable`. Removed the regex.
   - `utcCalendarDays` assertion `1 !== 3`: root cause was `postMainMessage` returning `main_unread_required` with `committed: false`, so the later operation was never written. Fixed by calling `ledger.readMainStream(...)` before posting (for both the Human and the Agent).
   - `ReferenceError: started is not defined` from an over-eager edit removing the `startThread` call. Restored the call.
   - `3 !== 1` on `immediateNotificationFactsByMember`: owners also receive immediate facts for new discussions; corrected the expectation to 3.
   - `deepStrictEqual` mismatch on `owners.byUtcDay`: actual `[{2026-10-24: 1}, {2026-10-26: 2}]`; updated the expectation (and this confirmed UTC bucketing works across the boundary).
   - `0 !== 1` on `agentReplies.total`: the Agent's reply also needed `readMainStream` first.

## 入口

# Distill Memory

Save proactively when the conversation produces a durable fact, preference, decision, plan, procedure, learning, event, or important context. Do not wait to be asked.

## When to Suggest (Moment Detection)

**Breakthrough:** Extended debugging resolves, user relief ("Finally!", "Aha!"), root cause found

**Decision:** Compared options, chose with rationale, trade-off resolved

**Research:** Investigated multiple approaches, conclusion reached, optimal path determined

**Twist:** Unexpected cause-effect, counterintuitive solution, assumption challenged

**Lesson:** "Next time do X", preventive measure, pattern recognized

**Skip:** Routine fixes, work in progress, simple Q&A, generic info

## Memory Quality

**Good (atomic + actionable):**

- "React hooks cleanup must return function. Caused leaks."
- "PostgreSQL over MongoDB: ACID needed for transactions."

**Poor:** Vague "Fixed bugs", conversation transcript

## Tool Usage

Use `nmem` CLI to create memories:

```bash
nmem m add "Insight + context for future use" \
  -t "Searchable title (50-60 chars)" \
  -i 0.8
```

Add `--unit-type fact|preference|decision|plan|procedure|learning|context|event` when the type is clear.

If an existing memory already captures the same decision, workflow, or preference and the new information refines it, update that memory instead of creating a duplicate:

```bash
nmem m update <id> -t "Updated title"
```

**Content:** Outcome/insight focus, include "why", enough context

**Importance:** 0.8-1.0 major | 0.5-0.7 useful | 0.3-0.4 minor

**Note:** For programmatic use, add `--json` flag to get JSON response

**Examples:**

```bash
# High-value insight
nmem m add "React hooks cleanup must return function. Caused memory leaks in event listeners." \
  -t "React Hooks Cleanup Pattern" \
  -i 0.9

# Decision with context
nmem m add "Chose PostgreSQL over MongoDB for ACID compliance and complex queries" \
  -t "Database: PostgreSQL" \
  -i 0.9
```

## Suggestion

**Timing:** After resolution/decision, when user pauses

**Pattern:** "This [type] seems valuable - [essence]. Distill into memory?"

**Frequency:** 1-3 per session typical, quality over quantity

## Troubleshooting

If `nmem` is not in PATH: `pip install nmem-cli`, or on Arch Linux `yay -S nmem-cli` / `paru -S nmem-cli`

For remote servers: run `nmem config client set url https://...` and `nmem config client set api-key ...` once on this machine.

Run `/status` to check server connection.

Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default.

## deepwiki
DeepWiki MCP provides AI-powered documentation for GitHub repositories.

With a user OAuth token, all devin_* tools act in one organization: without an X-Org-Id header, the first one the user joined. Not found usually means another of their orgs; send X-Org-Id: <org id> to switch.

Available tools:
- read_wiki_structure: Get a list of documentation topics for a repository
- read_wiki_contents: View full documentation about a repository
- ask_wiki_question: Ask any question about a repository's codebase and get an AI-powered answer from its wiki
- list_wiki_repos: List the repositories that have a DeepWiki index (private mode only)
- generate_wiki: Generate a codebase wiki for a repository — only use when explicitly requested by the user (private mode only)
- devin_automation_manage: Manage Devin automations — list, get, create, update, delete, or fetch the trigger event schemas (private mode only)
- devin_billing_tag_manage: Manage Devin billing tags (groupings of Devin sessions for usage tracking) — list, get, create, assign sessions, look up session tags (private mode only)
- devin_blueprint_test: Test a candidate blueprint YAML in an authoring VM: start → run initialize → fix → run initialize again (clean VM) → run maintenance → then persist with update_environment_config (private mode only)
- devin_campaign_manage: Read and publish a bot's campaign documents (plan, readings, status) — get, update, validate (private mode only)
- devin_code_scan_manage: Manage Devin code scans, sometimes referred to as 'security scans' or 'Devin Security Swarm' — list scans, list findings, list profiles, get a profile, create a scan, remediate a finding (private mode only)
- devin_knowledge_manage: Manage Devin knowledge notes and suggestions — list, search, get, create, update, delete notes, view folder structure, list/view/dismiss knowledge suggestions (private mode only)
- devin_mcp_server_manage: Manage org MCP server installations — install (marketplace or custom), update, enable, disable, delete (private mode only)
- devin_oncall_manage: Devin Oncall operations — create and manage Oncall responders (alert, bug report and support request triage), get an Oncall report's current responder membership, page through a responder's open issues, and ingest a dashboard into Oncall knowledge (private mode only)
- devin_playbook_manage: Manage Devin playbooks — list, get, create, update, delete (private mode only)
- devin_review_manage: Trigger a Devin Review for a pull request, fetch the latest review status, or fetch a completed review's findings (private mode only)
- devin_schedule_manage: Manage scheduled Devin sessions — list, get, create, update, delete (private mode only)
- devin_session_create: Create one or more child Devin sessions (private mode only)
- devin_session_interact: Manage a Devin session — get status (one or many sessions, optionally with a short AI summary of each), send messages, sleep/terminate/archive/unarchive, read messages & attachments, manage tags (private mode only)
- devin_session_events: Inspect session events — list summaries, fetch full details, or search event contents (private mode only)
- devin_session_search: Search and filter Devin sessions (private mode only)
- devin_session_insights: Per-session cost, message counts and AI analysis (issues, action items, classification) — list, get, generate (private mode only)
- devin_user_list: List the organization's users by membership kind (direct members or IdP-group members) (private mode only)
- devin_list_integrations: List all native integrations and MCP servers with their status and settings URLs (private mode only)
- devin_find_setting: Find Devin webapp settings pages and deep-link URLs for them (private mode only)

## 沟通规范

- 说人话，拒绝行业黑话、互联网黑话。
- 简洁优先。
- 只问真正需要用户拍板的问题。
- 模仿用户的表达方式。

## 文档与报告写作规范

适用于结构化文档与报告（故障报告、分析、清单等）；日常对话遵循“沟通规范”。

- 使用标准术语；已有通用说法时直接采用。
- 直接陈述，让读者无需推断指代对象；用字面表述代替比喻。
- 表头和分类名使用中性名词，如“问题”“现象”“影响”“结果”。
- 直接陈述结论或定义。
- 表格条目按需填写，说明发生了什么即可；数字和结论在有把握时给出。
- 未查明原因的问题写“原因未查明”。
- 使用正式、客观的表述。

## UI / UX 改动

- 涉及界面或交互改动时，用 ASCII UI 展示示意。

## 向用户汇报

用简单直白的语言说清楚：做了什么、结果怎样。

- 把术语和技术细节转成日常语言。
- 像在跟一个聪明人解释，对方没在看代码。
- 干活过程怎么都行；这条要求只针对汇报方式。

## 自验

在汇报前，先用实际工具验证工作结果：

- 能运行就运行，检查输出。
- Web 类：打开页面走一遍流程，确认渲染和交互正常。
- 脚本：拿真实输入跑，检查结果。
- 边界情况也试一遍。

发现问题就先修好，交付能用的成果，让用户拿到就能用。

## 完成标准

- 动手前先想清楚：任务做到什么程度才算完成。
- 先给自己列检查清单。
- 只有确认一切正常，或者真的遇到需要用户介入的障碍，才来找用户。

## 工具使用偏好

- 涉及 GitHub 的操作（查源码、读文件、发 API 请求、查 PR/Issue）优先用 `gh`。

## 方案与决策默认规则

- 默认追求在当前目标和约束下长期最优、完整、干净的最终方案；在充分满足需求的前提下采用尽可能简单的实现，抽象、配置项和间接层只在有实际需求依据时引入。
- 废弃的代码路径直接移除，连同兼容层、回退机制和迁移方案一并清理；旧接口、旧行为、旧结构只在用户明确要求时保留。替换时一次迁移到位，保持单一实现并存。
- 架构决策着眼长期演进，采用可长期承载的方案；提出的方案应是可长期保留的最终形态。
- 在自行实现或新增依赖之前，先评估项目现有依赖的能力：查阅相关文档和类型定义，确认其是否已具备所需能力。成熟且维护良好的库能降低整体复杂度或提高可靠性时优先采用，通用功能直接复用既有实现。
- 在设计解决方案之前，先研究成熟产品如何解决同类问题，优先采用经过验证的模式和约定。
- 采用渐进式、分层的方式构建系统：先完成能够端到端运行的最小版本，再基于稳定可用的产品逐步增加功能。保持组件模块化，明确划分不同职责与关注点。
- 需求、约束、意图、边界不清时，先问清楚再动手。长期最优方案和时间压力、现有约束冲突时，直接说清冲突点，再让用户确认。

## Memory / Nowledge Mem

把 `nmem` / Nowledge Mem 当作你和用户共同的长期记忆系统。它服务于协作连续性，沉淀跨会话有用的结论和上下文。

### 基本分工

- `Profile`：用户是谁、长期偏好、全局协作方式。
- `Space`：当前工作场景 / 项目 / agent lane。只有长期上下文会互相干扰时才建；方法类工作（调研、排障、写作、总结）留在 Default。
- `Working Memory`：某个 space 今天/近期最该记住的重点。会话开始或接续任务时优先读一次；同一会话读一次即可。
- `Memory`：一条长期有用的结论，写“决定了什么 + 为什么”。
- `Thread`：原始对话或 handoff。需要原文历史时查 thread；只要结论时查 memory。
- `Library`：原始资料、文档、网页、文件。资料保整体，结论再提炼成 memory。
- `Label / unit-type`：记忆类型和筛选方式，例如 `decision`、`procedure`、`preference`、`incident`、`current-state`、`historical`。label 只管记忆类型筛选，领域隔离交给 space。

### 什么时候搜索

- 做延续性任务、复盘、架构取舍、偏好判断、调试排障、相似问题前，先想是否该搜 memory。
- 用户提到“之前、上次、那个方案、为什么这样定”时，主动搜。
- 默认先搜 memory；如果用户问原始讨论、完整历史、某次对话细节，再搜 thread。
- 有明确 space 时，命令带 `--space "空间名"`；没有可靠场景信号时留在 Default。

### 什么时候沉淀

每个 agent turn 结束前快速自检：

- 是否形成稳定用户偏好？
- 是否做出长期决策和理由？
- 是否得到可复用流程？
- 是否找到排障根因或预防规则？
- 是否产生未来会话需要的项目背景或下一步？

只要答案是“长期会有用”，就保存或更新。

### 写入规则

- 写入前必须搜索相关记忆；已有同类结论时优先 update，保持一条强记忆。
- 及时更新记忆，写入、更新记忆都要**先读 distill-memory 相关 SKILL**。
- 中文默认，短、稳、客观；命令、路径、代码标识符、产品名保留英文原文。
- 目标：1-3 句，记“决定 + 理由”。配置清单、部署步骤、cron、commit hash、长路径列表放项目文档，只在 memory 里留项目文档引导。
- 只记长期有用的结论、决策、根因、偏好。
- 旧状态被新结论覆盖时，标记为历史，在现行记忆里写演化链。

### WSL 中的 nmem

- 在 WSL 内直接运行 `nmem`；
- `nmem` 已配置为连接本机的 Nowledge Mem 服务。遇到连接问题先运行 `nmem status`，复用本机已有的服务。

# Repository Guidelines

## Scope and authority

`dsh-agent-team` is an opt-in, externally installable Cordis bundle for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a single-host Agent Team without modifying the Harness repository, the agent loop, or shipped defaults.

Read [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md) first — it is the maintained documentation index.

Use this authority order:

1. **Current behavior:** source and tests under `packages/`. When prose disagrees with code, code wins.
2. **Maintained engineering guidance:** `docs/`. Update it when a code or workflow change invalidates it; it must not define behavior that the code does not implement.
3. **Harness contract:** `../deepseek-harness/docs/`, its applicable `AGENTS.md`, and the corresponding Harness source/tests.
4. **Work history:** `.scratch/` — active work items and archived design, research, tickets, prototypes, and validation evidence. It is not an implementation or API authority; its own [`AGENTS.md`](.scratch/AGENTS.md) governs how to work there, and the [`README.md`](.scratch/README.md) indexes it. Verify relevant history against code, tests, and the Harness contract.

Keep production code self-explanatory through clear names, types, and structure. Comments explain only non-obvious constraints, ownership, or reasons; they are not the sole definition of current behavior. The `check:comments` row in [`docs/development/start-and-checks.md`](docs/development/start-and-checks.md) holds the per-scope budget and the rules a comment's references must satisfy.

When deleting comments in bulk, a green test suite proves nothing about the change. Tests assert behavior; comments are text. Measure the edit itself instead: audit the diff so every removed line is a comment or a blank line, and treat any removed code line as a failure. Delete whole comment blocks rather than merged line ranges — a merged range swallows the code between two comments — and never normalize whitespace outside the lines you removed. This applies to any sweep over comments, including one driven by a subagent report: reports carry line numbers that drift, so verify each cited range against the current file before acting on it.

## Reading guidance

- Use the `docs/architecture/` pages for package ownership, Host authority, Remote, preset, and Client boundaries — not before every edit, only when a change crosses those boundaries: [`package-ownership.md`](docs/architecture/package-ownership.md), [`host-authority.md`](docs/architecture/host-authority.md), [`tools-and-preset.md`](docs/architecture/tools-and-preset.md), [`client-and-remote.md`](docs/architecture/client-and-remote.md), [`workspace-session-storage.md`](docs/architecture/workspace-session-storage.md).
- Use [`docs/harness-navigation.md`](docs/harness-navigation.md) for cross-repository routes when a change consumes a Harness capability.
- Treat `.scratch/` as background context, not as a specification to implement blindly. New cross-session work belongs in one `.scratch/active/<work>/` directory; close it into the archive only after durable conclusions have moved to maintained documents.

## Architecture guardrails

- `packages/agent-team` is the only Team authority. Its append-only operation ledger is the durable source of Team facts; projections, tools, commands, Remote, and UI do not maintain parallel authority.
- `packages/tool-agent-team` provides the seven model-facing Team tools only through the explicit `team-member` preset. The Web Client is the only Human Team control surface; do not restore a slash-command adapter.
- Team is an external plugin. Do not modify `../deepseek-harness`, its agent loop, or shipped defaults for ordinary Team work. If a public Harness extension point is insufficient, record the limitation and decide whether to implement a Team-owned plugin or change the design.
- Typed Remote declarations are the input; Typert artifacts are generated. Never hand-edit `packages/agent-team/lib/typert.*`.
- The Client uses public Harness plugin and slot APIs. Mount the generated Remote, wait for `remote.agentTeam`, and use `ctx.slots.inject()` when a declaration may not exist yet; `dsh.client.inject` is not an activation-order guarantee.
- A slot parent’s `children` declaration is its render authority. Do not copy private shipped UI or redeclare `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` from the Team workspace shadow; live duplicate child declarations are rejected by Harness SlotCore, regardless of priority.
- Keep durable UI mutations non-optimistic. Authorization, membership, revisions, idempotency, and stable branded refs are enforced by the Host.
- Keep Team tools/guidance inside the isolated Team preset. Ordinary Sessions must not acquire Team behavior accidentally.

## Code and documentation conventions

- Use ESM, strict TypeScript, `.ts`/`.tsx` local imports, existing package names, and existing branded domain types.
- Keep one authoritative formatter/projection per domain concept. Do not add speculative registries, compatibility layers, fallback authorities, or duplicate stores.
- Do not hand-edit generated `tsconfig*.json` path facades. Change `scripts/sync-paths.mjs` and regenerate.
- Update the affected maintained document, package README, and tests when a non-trivial change alters a public contract or workflow. Do not update archived `.scratch/` material merely to make it agree with new code.
- Follow [`docs/AGENTS.md`](docs/AGENTS.md) when editing or adding maintained documents — routing branches and the maintenance discipline live there.
- For visible UI changes, run the applicable component checks and `npm run test:browser`, inspect the new `artifacts/browser/` screenshots at desktop and 390×844, and verify keyboard/focus, dialog/menu accessibility, loading/error/empty states, and ordinary DSH restoration. Keep only a small, human-approved milestone set under `.scratch/archive/.../validation/`; routine screenshots stay ignored.
- Write each commit message as one Conventional Commits subject line: `type: lowercase imperative summary` (`feat`, `fix`, `chore`, `refactor`, `test`, `perf`, `docs`), with no body. Match the existing `git log` style.
- Do not commit credentials, temporary profiles, browser overlays, generated test files, browser artifacts, or build residue.

## Checks

Run the narrowest applicable check, then escalate for the changed surface. The exact workflow is in [`docs/development/start-and-checks.md`](docs/development/start-and-checks.md).

`npm run test:browser` is required for changes that can affect the assembled Web bundle, Client loading, slot takeover, Remote activation, or visible UI. It uses the adjacent Harness checkout and a temporary profile; it does not modify the Harness repository permanently.

Release cadence is batched: between releases the operator daily-drives a locally linked build as a lightweight acceptance channel, so choose the narrowest applicable check per change instead of demanding full acceptance for every small fix. When asking the operator to preview or accept a change, point them at the dev profile (`dsh web --profile web-dev`); the default `web` profile stays on the published stable release. See "Profile 模式与发布节奏" in [`docs/development/environments-and-install.md`](docs/development/environments-and-install.md).

## Further reading

- Domain and Host behavior: `packages/agent-team/src/`, its tests, and `docs/architecture/README.md`.
- Tools and preset: `packages/tool-agent-team/`, `packages/agent-team/preset/`, and the matching Harness subsystem docs.
- Client or UI: `packages/client-agent-team/src/client/`, `docs/architecture/README.md`, and `docs/harness-navigation.md`; consult the relevant `.scratch/archive/` work history only when needed, and verify all behavior in code and tests.

- 在自行实现或新增依赖之前，先评估项目现有依赖的能力：查阅相关文档和类型定义，确认其是否已具备所需能力。成熟且维护良好的库能降低整体复杂度或提高可靠性时优先采用，通用功能直接复用既有实现。
- 在设计解决方案之前，先研究成熟产品如何解决同类问题，优先采用经过验证的模式和约定。
- 采用渐进式、分层的方式构建系统：先完成能够端到端运行的最小版本，再基于稳定可用的产品逐步增加功能。保持组件模块化，明确划分不同职责与关注点。
- 需求、约束、意图、边界不清时，先问清楚再动手。长期最优方案和时间压力、现有约束冲突时，直接说清冲突点，再让用户确认。

## Memory / Nowledge Mem

把 `nmem` / Nowledge Mem 当作你和用户共同的长期记忆系统。它服务于协作连续性，沉淀跨会话有用的结论和上下文。

### 基本分工

- `Profile`：用户是谁、长期偏好、全局协作方式。
- `Space`：当前工作场景 / 项目 / agent lane。只有长期上下文会互相干扰时才建；方法类工作（调研、排障、写作、总结）留在 Default。
- `Working Memory`：某个 space 今天/近期最该记住的重点。会话开始或接续任务时优先读一次；同一会话读一次即可。
- `Memory`：一条长期有用的结论，写“决定了什么 + 为什么”。
- `Thread`：原始对话或 handoff。需要原文历史时查 thread；只要结论时查 memory。
- `Library`：原始资料、文档、网页、文件。资料保整体，结论再提炼成 memory。
- `Label / unit-type`：记忆类型和筛选方式，例如 `decision`、`procedure`、`preference`、`incident`、`current-state`、`historical`。label 只管记忆类型筛选，领域隔离交给 space。

### 什么时候搜索

- 做延续性任务、复盘、架构取舍、偏好判断、调试排障、相似问题前，先想是否该搜 memory。
- 用户提到“之前、上次、那个方案、为什么这样定”时，主动搜。
- 默认先搜 memory；如果用户问原始讨论、完整历史、某次对话细节，再搜 thread。
- 有明确 space 时，命令带 `--space "空间名"`；没有可靠场景信号时留在 Default。

### 什么时候沉淀

每个 agent turn 结束前快速自检：

- 是否形成稳定用户偏好？
- 是否做出长期决策和理由？
- 是否得到可复用流程？
- 是否找到排障根因或预防规则？
- 是否产生未来会话需要的项目背景或下一步？

只要答案是“长期会有用”，就保存或更新。

### 写入规则

- 写入前必须搜索相关记忆；已有同类结论时优先 update，保持一条强记忆。
- 及时更新记忆，写入、更新记忆都要**先读 distill-memory 相关 SKILL**。
- 中文默认，短、稳、客观；命令、路径、代码标识符、产品名保留英文原文。
- 目标：1-3 句，记“决定 + 理由”。配置清单、部署步骤、cron、commit hash、长路径列表放项目文档，只在 memory 里留项目文档引导。
- 只记长期有用的结论、决策、根因、偏好。
- 旧状态被新结论覆盖时，标记为历史，在现行记忆里写演化链。

### WSL 中的 nmem

- 在 WSL 内直接运行 `nmem`；
- `nmem` 已配置为连接本机的 Nowledge Mem 服务。遇到连接问题先运行 `nmem status`，复用本机已有的服务。
